title: Admin & Executive Support Specialist
description:
Admin & Executive Support Specialist



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and dependable Admin & Executive Support Specialist who can help keep our day-to-day operations organized and ensure that important tasks, communications, schedules, documents, and recruitment activities are properly managed.



This is not a role for someone who simply waits for instructions.



We need someone who takes ownership, follows through, communicates clearly, keeps things organized, and makes sure nothing important falls through the cracks.



You should be comfortable working independently, handling confidential information, coordinating with different people, and managing multiple priorities at the same time.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Executive & Administrative Support

Provide day-to-day administrative support to management.

Organize and maintain important documents, records, and information.

Prepare documents, reports, summaries, trackers, and other administrative materials when needed.

Maintain organized digital folders and documentation.

Keep track of important requests, follow-ups, deadlines, and pending items.

Assist management with research and administrative coordination.

Make sure assigned tasks are properly documented and followed through until completion.

Handle sensitive and confidential information professionally.



2.
 Management & Communication

Monitor and organize company
 communications.

Identify messages that require immediate attention or follow-up.

Draft professional
 responses when requested.

Organize
s, correspondence, and important information.

Follow up on unanswered or pending communications.

Help ensure important messages are not overlooked.

Maintain professional communication with employees, applicants, vendors, partners, and other contacts.



3. Calendar & Schedule Management

Maintain and organize management calendars.

Schedule meetings, appointments, interviews, and internal discussions.

Coordinate availability between participants.

Help prevent scheduling conflicts.

Send reminders for important meetings and deadlines.

Keep management informed of upcoming commitments.

Make schedule adjustments when priorities change.



4. Recruitment & Hiring Support

Create and publish job postings across approved recruitment platforms.

Source and identify qualified candidates based on the company’s hiring requirements.

Review applications and conduct initial candidate screening.

Shortlist qualified candidates for management review and interviews.

Coordinate interview schedules and follow up with candidates.

Maintain an organized candidate tracker showing each applicant’s current hiring status.

Communicate professionally with candidates throughout the recruitment process.

Assist with job offers, pre-employment requirements, and onboarding coordination.

Maintain an active talent pool for future hiring needs.

Provide regular updates on recruitment progress, pending interviews, and open positions.



5. Task & Follow-Up Management

Maintain an organized list of ongoing, pending, and completed tasks.

Follow up with responsible individuals regarding outstanding deliverables.

Track deadlines and commitments.

Flag overdue or potentially delayed items.

Provide management with clear status updates.

Make sure instructions are documented accurately.

Follow through on assigned tasks instead of waiting to be reminded.



6. Documentation & File Organization

Maintain a structured digital filing system.

Organize company documents so they can be easily located when needed.

Maintain administrative records and trackers.

Keep documents properly named, categorized, and updated.

Assist in documenting company procedures and administrative processes.

Help maintain internal templates, forms, checklists, and SOPs.



7. Meeting & Coordination Support

Help prepare information needed before meetings.

Coordinate meeting schedules and participants.

Take or organize meeting notes when required.

Document decisions, deliverables, and follow-up items.

Track action items after meetings.

Follow up with responsible team members regarding agreed deliverables.



8. General Operations Support

Assist management with day-to-day operational coordination.

Coordinate with different departments when administrative support is required.

Help collect updates and information requested by management.

Maintain visibility of pending administrative and operational matters.

Identify administrative issues before they become bigger problems.

Recommend improvements to administrative processes when appropriate.

Take ownership of recurring administrative responsibilities.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is:



Highly organized and detail-oriented

Proactive rather than reactive

Reliable and accountable

Comfortable working independently

Strong at following instructions

Equally comfortable asking questions when something is genuinely unclear

Able to manage multiple priorities without losing track of details

Professional in written and verbal communication

Consistent with follow-ups

Comfortable communicating with candidates and team members

Able to maintain confidentiality

Resourceful and capable of solving routine problems independently

Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities may change



REQUIRED SKILLS



Strong written and spoken English

Administrative or executive support experience

Excellent organizational and time-management skills

Professional
 communication

Calendar and scheduling management

Recruitment and candidate coordination

Candidate screening and applicant tracking

Document and file management

Task tracking and follow-up

Strong attention to detail

Ability to work with spreadsheets, documents, and online collaboration tools

Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly



Experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Recruitment Assistant, HR Assistant, or Operations Assistant is an advantage.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE



Success is not measured simply by being online or completing isolated tasks.



A successful Admin & Executive Support Specialist helps create order, visibility, and accountability.



Management should be able to quickly understand:



What needs to be done

What has already been completed

What is currently in progress

What is delayed or requires attention

Which communications require a response

Which meetings and deadlines are coming up

Which candidates are moving through recruitment

Which positions are still open

What needs management approval or a decision



The goal is simple: keep things organized, keep things moving, and make sure important matters do not get forgotten.



WORKING STYLE

Take Ownership



If something is assigned to you, take responsibility for moving it forward.



Communicate Early



If there is a problem, delay, or missing information, communicate it before it becomes an issue.



Stay Organized



Do not rely solely on memory. Use trackers, calendars, documentation, and systems.



Follow Through



Starting a task is not the same as completing it.



Think Ahead



If you notice something that management will likely need, bring it forward proactively.



Protect Confidentiality



You may have access to management communications, company information, employee information, candidate information, and credentials. Professional discretion is essential.



BEFORE YOU APPLY



Please read the entire job description carefully.



We are looking for someone who understands that this position is not simply about completing tasks as they are assigned. It is about helping management stay organized, maintaining visibility over important matters, following through consistently, and taking ownership of responsibilities.



If you are someone who waits to be reminded repeatedly, struggles to keep track of details, or requires constant supervision to complete routine responsibilities, this role may not be the right fit.



If you are organized, proactive, dependable, professional, and comfortable taking ownership, we would like to hear from you.

title: Sourcing Agent for Clothing Brand - China manufacturers, custom production, must have done this for real brands
description:
Hi! We run a streetwear and hikewear clothing brand - jackets and tracksuits

mainly. We're growing and finding and vetting factories is eating our time, so

we want one experienced person to own it.



This is not a research job for a beginner. We need someone who has genuinely

done this before, for real clothing brands, and can prove it.



THE WORK

- Find and vet manufacturers in China for our products. 1688, Alibaba, trade

  shows, agent networks, wherever you actually get good factories - we care

  about the result, not the source. - 

- Custom branding on existing products: our logo printed, embroidered, debossed

  or engraved onto stock items like wallets, caps and accessories. Getting a

  real branded sample made, not a mockup.

- Fully custom production from our tech packs: fabric and trim sourcing, sample

  rounds, fit corrections, then bulk.

- Negotiate. We will give you a target landed cost per unit and your job is to

  hit it, or come back and tell us why it can't be hit.

- Bring our existing costs down. We have products in production now. We want the

  same or better quality for less.

- Handle MOQs, sample costs, lead times, payment terms and who pays for what.

- Be the person we message when we have a new design, and come back with options.



HOW WE WANT IT REPORTED (this part matters as much as the sourcing)

For every product, one short summary we can read in two minutes:

- The shortlisted suppliers, ranked, with your recommendation at the top

- Unit price at our quantity, MOQ, sample cost, sample lead time, bulk lead time

- Pros and cons for each one, in your own words

- What you have actually verified versus what the supplier claims

We do not want a wall of screenshots or a 40-row spreadsheet. We want a decision

we can make quickly, with the reasoning underneath it.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU (please read this part properly)

YOU KNOW HOW TO GET PAST ALIBABA. Most of what's listed there is a trading

  company putting a margin on a factory's price, which is exactly the problem

  we're hiring you to fix. Tell us how you find the factory behind the listing.

- YOU HAVE DONE THIS FOR CLOTHING OR APPAREL BRANDS BEFORE. Name them. Say what

  you sourced, where from, and roughly what volume. This is the single biggest

  thing we are hiring on.

- A REAL EXAMPLE OF A PRICE YOU NEGOTIATED DOWN. The product, the first quote,

  the price you landed, and how you got there. One paragraph is fine.

- Experience with CUSTOM BRANDING on existing products - print, embroidery,

  engraving, debossing, custom packaging and labels. Tell us what you've had

  branded and how it came out.

- Experience taking a TECH PACK to a finished sample and into bulk.

- You know how to avoid the overpriced middlemen. A lot of what's listed on

  Alibaba is a trading company marking up a factory. Tell us how you tell the

  difference.

- Excellent written English, and you can communicate with Chinese suppliers

  (tell us how - your own Mandarin, WeChat with translation, an agent you work

  with, whatever it actually is. We'd rather know than be told what we want to

  hear.)

- You can work to a target price we set and push back honestly when it's not

  realistic.



WHAT WE DON'T NEED

- AN ALIBABA SPECIALIST. If your experience is searching Alibaba and
ing

  gold suppliers, this is not the role. We can search Alibaba ourselves. We are

  already paying middleman prices and that is the thing we want fixed.

- A sourcing agency or a factory's sales rep. We're hiring one person who works

  for us, not someone who gets paid by the supplier.

- Someone who will send us the first three Alibaba listings they find. We can

  search Alibaba ourselves. We're paying for judgement and relationships.

- A team. One person.



HOURS AND PAY

Around 10-15 hours a week to start, long-term, with more as we grow. Paid

weekly.

$5-8 USD/hour depending on what you've actually done, reviewed after the first

month. If you'd rather be paid per project, tell us how you normally structure

it and we'll consider it.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your reply with the word ANVIL so we know you read this.



Then send us:

1. The clothing or apparel brands you have sourced for, and what you sourced

2. The price you negotiated down - product, first quote, final price, how

3. What custom branding you have had done, and on what products

4. How you communicate with Chinese suppliers

5. How you tell a real factory from a trading company

6. What hours you can work, in your local time, and your time zone

7. Your WhatsApp number

title: YouTube Video Editor & Channel Manager
description:
### Job Description



We are looking for a skilled, creative, and reliable **YouTube Video Editor & Channel Manager** who can take raw video footage and turn it into professional, engaging, and high-quality YouTube content.



The ideal candidate must have experience editing long-form YouTube videos, creating short-form content, managing YouTube channels, and optimizing content to increase views, engagement, and subscribers.



### Key Responsibilities



Video Editing

- Edit long-form YouTube videos (approximately 8–15 minutes).

- Create engaging short-form videos and YouTube Shorts from long-form content as a regular part of the role.

- Add B-roll, graphics, transitions, music, and captions.

- Improve video pacing, storytelling, audio, and overall quality.

- Ensure consistent editing style and branding.

- Optimize short-form videos for audience retention and engagement.



YouTube Channel Management

- Upload, schedule, and publish YouTube videos and Shorts.

- Create engaging, high-quality thumbnails.

- Write SEO-optimized titles, descriptions, and tags.

- Conduct keyword research to improve video discoverability.

- Organize playlists and maintain a consistent publishing schedule.

- Monitor YouTube analytics and provide recommendations for growth.



### Requirements



- Proven experience editing both long-form and short-form YouTube videos.

- Experience managing and optimizing YouTube channels.

- Knowledge of YouTube SEO, audience retention, and engagement strategies.

- Proficiency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar editing software.

- Strong attention to detail and creativity.

- Ability to meet deadlines and work independently.

- Good English communication skills.

- Experience editing real estate or educational YouTube content is a plus.



### What Will Be Provided



- Raw video footage.

- Video topics and general content direction.

- Branding materials and guidelines.

- Feedback and instructions when needed.



*Filming and full scriptwriting are not required.*



### How to Apply



Please send the following:



1. Your resume or brief introduction.

2. Portfolio with links to at least 2–3 long-form YouTube videos and examples of short-form content you've edited.

3. Examples of YouTube channels you've managed, if applicable.

4. Your expected rate (per video or monthly).

5. Your estimated turnaround time for both long-form and short-form videos.

6. How many videos you can realistically complete per month.

7. The editing software you use.



Important: Start your application with "YouTube Editor" so we know you've read the full job description.

title: Social Media Engagement Specialist
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW



We are a home-renovation group in the Netherlands with a bathroom brand, a tile brand, a bathroom-installation brand and a wider group of home-improvement brands. Our content team films in our showroom and at customers' homes; our brands' Instagram,
 and 
 accounts are where that content lands and where conversations with future customers start. We are hiring two people for this role: one for our bathroom and tile brands, one for the group brands. Same job, same hours, same pay. We d
 the split after the interviews.



JOB DESCRIPTION



You keep our brand accounts alive and growing with real interaction, every day. You are not the one who films or designs the content: our creative director, video editor and AI content creator deliver it. You schedule it from the content calendar, you publish it, you reply to every comment and message, and you go out and start conversations with the right people: homeowners who are renovating, interior accounts, local businesses and installers. All of it in Dutch, from approved templates through our AI workflow, with a Dutch-speaking colleague who checks anything new. When someone in your DMs is clearly looking for a bathroom, tiles or an installer, you hand them over to our sales team with the context they need.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS



Daily engagement routine per account: a target list of accounts and hashtags in our niche, meaningful comments and replies (not “nice!”), saves and follows, and DMs that start a conversation. Logged every day.

Reply to every comment and message on our own posts within the agreed time, in Dutch, from approved templates and reply suggestions. Ask the follow-up question that keeps the conversation going.

Schedule and publish from the content calendar (Metricool): reels, carousels, stories and TikToks that the content team delivers, at the right times for the Dutch audience, with the right captions and hashtags.

Make simple posts and stories yourself in Canva from brand templates when the calendar has a gap or something topical comes up: a showroom photo, a poll, a before-and-after.

Spot the leads: anyone in the comments or DMs who is actually renovating or looking for a supplier goes to our sales team in our CRM, with what they said and what they need. Partners (installers, stores) go the same way.

Weekly numbers per account: followers, reach, engagement rate, DMs started and received, hand-overs made, and the three posts that worked best and why.

Tell the content team what the audience reacts to, which questions keep coming back, and what competitors are doing that works.



REQUIRED SKILLS



You have run engagement for a brand or client account, not only your own: tell us the account, the niche, what you did daily and what happened to the numbers over a period you choose.

Instinct for real interaction. You know the difference between a comment that starts a conversation and one that reads as spam, and you can show us examples you wrote.

Canva: you make clean posts and stories from a template, fast. Show us two or three you made for an interior, home or lifestyle account.

Disciplined daily rhythm: the accounts don't pause on weekends, so we agree a schedule and you keep it. You log what you did without being asked.

You work strictly with templates and a Dutch check for anything you publish in Dutch. One wrong sentence on a brand account is seen by thousands.

You know Instagram,
 and 
 as a professional: what each algorithm rewards, what gets an account restricted, and how to use the scheduler and insights.

Clear written English for your weekly numbers and for working with the team.



TOOLS WE USE



Experience with these is a plus. Tell us which ones you have worked with.



Instagram,
 and 
 business accounts, with Meta Business Suite.

Metricool for scheduling and reporting.

Canva Teams with brand templates.

An AI assistant and DeepL for Dutch texts, with a native check.

Bitrix24 (CRM) for hand-overs and chat with the team.



NICE TO HAVE



Experience in the home, interior, bathroom or renovation niche.

Experience with accounts for a physical store or showroom (local audience, visits as the goal).

Short-form video basics: trimming a clip, adding captions, posting a reel from raw material.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY



Part-time, about 20 hours per week, spread over 5 to 6 days, including a short check on weekends. Our audience is most active in the Dutch evening, which is late evening in the Philippines, so we agree together which hours you cover. You have a weekly check-in with our head of content during Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST). A reliable, high-speed internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS



Followers are not the goal; conversations are. We expect you to show up every day, to treat every comment and DM as a person and not a metric, to log honestly what you did and what it produced, and to tell us when something in the content isn't working, even if we made it.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY



$159/month. Part-time now, with room to grow to more hours and more accounts. Long-term, stable role. Two positions.



BONUSES



Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word “REPLY” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these four questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:



Describe one account you ran engagement for (a brand or client, not your own): the niche, your daily routine, and the numbers over a period you choose (followers, reach, engagement rate, DMs, leads). What did you change that made the biggest difference?

Here are three posts you would see on an interior account: (a) a before-and-after of a small bathroom renovation, (b) a photo of a tile wall in a showroom, (c) a reel of an installer fitting a shower. Write one comment for each, in English, that starts a conversation with the account owner. No “nice!”, no emoji-only, no “check our page”.

Someone replies under a post of ours: “Looks great, we're renovating our bathroom in the spring, roughly what does something like this cost?” Write your reply in English, as you would brief it to our Dutch check, and say what you do next with this person.

Our accounts are in Dutch and you don't speak it. How do you write comments and replies, judge whether a reply from our templates fits the situation, and read 50 comments a day in a language you don't speak? Be specific about your workflow and where you would want a Dutch colleague to check.



Also include:



Links to two or three Canva posts or stories you made for an interior, home or lifestyle account, and the handle of one account you ran engagement for. Only share what already exists; please don't build anything for this.

Which hours (Philippine time) you can cover, including weekends, and which hours you are available for a check-in with our Dutch team.



We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or copy-paste replies aren't considered.

Customer Relations Specialist

Location: Miami, FL -remote

Job Type: Full-Time



About Us



Solution Based Homebuyers is a fast-growing real estate investment company specializing in identifying, acquiring, and managing residential properties. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment and are expanding our Customer Relations team in Miami.



Position Overview



Once our Acquisitions team signs an agreement with a seller, the file is transferred to Customer Relations. As a Customer Relations Specialist, you will take ownership of the seller relationship and help guide the transaction from contract to closing.



Your responsibility is to maintain strong communication with the seller, keep the deal moving forward, resolve issues, and renegotiate terms when necessary to ensure the transaction remains viable.



This is not a traditional customer service position. It is a customer-facing role that combines relationship management, negotiation, sales, and problem-solving. Successful team members are confident communicators who can protect the relationship while also protecting the profitability of the deal.

title: Static Ad Designer for Clothing Brand - Meta and TikTok ads, must have done apparel (send Drive folder)
description:
Hi! We run a streetwear and hikewear clothing brand - jackets and tracksuits

mainly. We're looking for someone to make our static image ads for Meta and

TikTok.



To be clear about what this is: we are not looking for a graphic designer who

makes nice looking posts. We're looking for someone who makes ads that sell, and

who knows the difference.



We are hiring on your previous work and the brands you made it for. So the most

important thing in your application is a folder we can actually look through.



THE WORK

- Static ad creatives for Meta and TikTok. Product shots, offer ads, comparison

  ads, review and testimonial ads, feature and fabric callouts, size and fit,

  shipping and guarantee, before and after.

- Bottom of funnel is most of this job. The ads that close someone who already

  knows us - the offer, the proof, the objection. If that phrase doesn't mean

  anything to you, this isn't the right role.

- Iterations. When a concept works we want variations of it to test - different

  headline, different layout, different angle, different colourway - so we can

  find out what's actually doing the work.

- Sized correctly for each placement, and readable at phone size.

- You'll get the product photos, the UGC, the reviews and the offer from us.

  You're designing, not shooting.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU (please read this part properly)

- A GOOGLE DRIVE FOLDER OF YOUR STATIC ADS. Images, not a PDF deck, so we can

  scroll it. Set it so anyone with the link can view. If we can't open it we

  can't consider you.

- APPAREL WORK IN THAT FOLDER. Clothing, streetwear, outdoor, sportswear,

  activewear. Not ecommerce in general. Clothing ads have their own look and

  their own objections - fit, sizing, quality, price - and we're hiring for that

  specifically.

- NAME THE BRANDS and say which ads in the folder belong to which brand.

- PERFORMANCE, if you have it. CTR, ROAS, CPA, hook rate, whatever you were

  shown - say which ads the numbers belong to. If you never had access to the ad

  account, say that honestly instead of making something up. It will not count

  against you. What we want to know either way is in question 4 below.

- Show us ITERATIONS. Put one concept in the folder with its variations, so we

  can see how you test, not just your best single image.

- Good written English. You'll be reading briefs and writing ad copy lines.



WHAT WE DON'T NEED

- A team or an agency. We're hiring one person directly.

- A logo, branding or packaging portfolio. Different job.

- Someone who needs the copy written for them every time. We'll give you the

  offer and the angle; the headline on the image is part of your job.

- Someone who shoots. We send you the photos.



HOURS AND PAY

Around 10-15 hours a week to start, long-term, with more as we scale spend.

Paid weekly.

$6-9 USD/hour depending on your work and your experience, reviewed after the

first month.

If you'd rather be paid per creative, quote us a price per CONCEPT that includes

3 variations of it, so we're both clear what a job is.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your reply with the word GRANITE so we know you read this.



Then send us:

1. Your Google Drive link, set to "anyone with the link can view"

2. The brands you made those ads for, and which ads are whose. Say which of them

   sell clothing.

3. Any performance numbers you have, and which ads they belong to

4. Of all the ads in that folder, which ONE performed best? How did you know,

   and what did you change in the next version because of it?

5. What hours you can work, in your local time, and your time zone

6. Your WhatsApp number

title: Senior QuickBooks Accounting Manager – US Clients & Construction
description:
Remote | Part-Time Initially | $10–$12 USD/Hour | Growth to Full-Time Potential



About Summit FP&A Solutions



Summit FP&A Solutions is a growing U.S.-based financial consulting company specializing in financial planning, profitability improvement, and fractional CFO services.



We work with small and mid-sized businesses, including remodeling and construction companies and residential care businesses.



We're looking for an experienced, highly independent accounting professional who can take full ownership of bookkeeping operations across multiple U.S. clients.



This is not an entry-level bookkeeping or data-entry role. We need someone with strong accounting judgment who can identify problems, resolve discrepancies, and maintain accurate financial records with minimal supervision.



Key Responsibilities



Bookkeeping & Accounting Management

- Independently manage QuickBooks Online bookkeeping for multiple U.S.-based clients.

- Perform bank, credit card, and balance sheet account reconciliations.

- Complete historical bookkeeping cleanup and catch-up projects.

- Review and correct transaction classifications and journal entries.

- Maintain accurate charts of accounts and client-level reporting structures.

- Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and outstanding balances.

- Prepare monthly financial statements, including profit and loss and balance sheet reports.

- Identify unusual transactions, missing information, and accounting discrepancies.

- Maintain organized month-end close documentation.



Construction & Project Accounting

- Track project expenses and profitability through QuickBooks Online.

- Manage construction job costing and project-level expense classifications.

- Understand progress billing, deposits, subcontractor payments, retainage, and change orders.

- Reconcile project billings and payments against accounting records.

- Support accurate financial reporting by construction project.



Client Accounting Oversight

- Independently manage assigned client accounts and monthly close deadlines.

- Proactively communicate missing information and outstanding reconciliation items.

- Maintain consistent bookkeeping procedures across multiple businesses.

- Escalate accounting issues requiring management decisions.

- Prepare clean financial records for tax preparers and CFO-level financial analysis.



Required Qualifications



- Minimum 5 years of professional bookkeeping or accounting experience, including substantial experience with QuickBooks Online.

- Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online, including reconciliations, journal entries, reporting, and historical cleanup.

- Verifiable QuickBooks certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise; active QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification strongly preferred.

- Demonstrated construction accounting experience, including job costing and progress billing.

- Experience supporting U.S.-based businesses and accounting practices.

- Strong understanding of accrual accounting and financial statements.

- Experience managing multiple client accounts independently.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and professional judgment.

- Ability to work independently without daily supervision.



A bachelor's degree in accounting or a related field is preferred. A CPA license is not required.



Employment Structure & Compensation



- Initial position: Part-time, hourly independent contractor.

- Starting compensation: $10–$12 USD per hour, based on experience.

- Initial workload: Approximately 2-10 hours per week as needed, with hours approved in advance. Actual hours may be lower during the initial transition.

- Workload will increase as new clients are onboarded.

- Potential to transition into a full-time role as business demand grows; full-time employment is not guaranteed.

- Flexible working schedule with availability for scheduled meetings during Arizona business hours (7:30 AM–4:30 PM MST, UTC−7).



How to Apply



Please provide the following:



1. Your resume and total years of professional accounting experience.

2. How many years you have used QuickBooks Online professionally.

3. Your QuickBooks certification and a way to verify it, if applicable.

4. A description of your experience with U.S. construction accounting, specifically job costing and progress billing.

5. An example of a difficult bookkeeping cleanup or reconciliation project you independently completed.

6. The number of U.S. clients you've managed simultaneously.

7. Your requested hourly rate and current weekly availability.



Please begin your application with "SUMMIT ACCOUNTING" to confirm you've read the full job description.



Selected candidates will participate in a short video interview and a paid, practical QuickBooks/accounting assessment using fictional data.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with our company, take ownership of their responsibilities, and become a long-term member of our accounting team.

title: Xero Bookkeeper for Australian Ecommerce Brand - GST, bank reconciliation, long-term
description:
Hi! We run a streetwear and hikewear clothing brand selling online. We're

Australian, GST registered, and we run our books in Xero.



We've grown faster than our bookkeeping and we have a backlog of unreconciled

transactions. We want one person to clear it, and then keep it clean every week

so it never happens again.



This is a long-term role, not a one-off cleanup job. The cleanup is just how it

starts.



THE WORK

- Reconcile the bank feeds in Xero, weekly, and keep them at zero.

- Code transactions correctly, including the GST treatment on each one.

- Reconcile our online payouts. Our sales platform and payment processors pay us

  out in lump sums that are already net of their fees, so a single deposit

  covers many orders minus a fee - that has to be broken out properly, not

  matched to one invoice.

- Handle foreign currency. We buy in USD and from overseas suppliers, so there

  are FX differences to deal with.

- Chase and file the paperwork - supplier invoices, receipts, anything missing

  behind a transaction.

- Keep supplier and customer accounts tidy, flag duplicates and anything that

  looks wrong.

- Prepare our GST position each quarter so our accountant can review and lodge.

- Give us a short monthly summary: what's reconciled, what's outstanding, and

  anything you weren't sure how to treat.



THE FIRST JOB

Clearing the backlog. That's more hours than the ongoing work, and we'll pay for

them. Tell us roughly how long you'd expect a backlog clean-up to take once you

can see the file - we're not holding you to a number from a job post, we just

want to see how you'd think about it.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU (please read this part properly)

- XERO. Not "I can learn it", not QuickBooks only. Say how long you've used it,

  how many businesses you've run in it, and whether you're Xero certified.

- EXPERIENCE WITH AUSTRALIAN CLIENTS AND AUSTRALIAN GST. This is the part most

  applicants don't have and it's the part that costs us if it's wrong. If you

  haven't done AU GST, say so honestly - it isn't an automatic no, but we need

  to know before we start, not after.

- ECOMMERCE BOOKKEEPING. Online store, payment processor payouts, fees, refunds,

  chargebacks. Service-business bookkeeping only is not the same job.

- You tell us when you're not sure instead of coding it and moving on. A

  confident wrong entry is worse to us than a question. We mean this.

- Excellent written English. You'll be writing us summaries we act on.

- Reliable internet, and a quiet private place to work. You'll have access to

  our financial records, so we need to know where you're working from.



WHAT WE DON'T NEED

- An accounting firm or an agency. We're hiring one person directly.

- Someone to lodge anything or give us tax advice. Our accountant does that.

  You prepare, we review.

- Someone juggling fifteen clients who fits us in. We want regular weekly hours.



HOURS AND PAY

Heavier for the first month while the backlog is cleared, then around 5-8 hours

a week ongoing, long-term. Paid weekly.

$5-7 USD/hour depending on your experience and your Australian/GST background,

reviewed after the first month.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your reply with the word BEACON so we know you read this.



Then send us:

1. How long you've used Xero, how many businesses, and whether you're certified

2. Which Australian clients you've worked with and what you did on their GST

3. We receive one lump payout from our sales platform that is already net of

   their fees, covering many orders. How do you reconcile that in Xero? Answer

   it properly, in your own words.

4. A supplier invoice arrives from China with no GST on it. How do you code it?

5. What accounting software you've used other than Xero

6. What hours you can work, in your local time, and your time zone

7. Your WhatsApp number

title: Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager
description:
SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER



Salary: $3,500 – $5,000 USD / month (Base) + Aggressive Annual Performance Bonus tied to KPI achievement

Remote | Full-time |



*****ABOUT THE ROLE*****



ARE YOU THE SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER WE’RE LOOKING FOR? 🎸⚡️



Intent Brands operates SurviveX (first-aid and preparedness products) and Aerotrunk (luggage).

Website: 
/

: 



We are seeking an exceptional, numbers-driven Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager to take

end-to-end commercial and operational ownership of our unified Amazon Seller Central account.



Currently generating approximately $20 million in trailing 12-month revenue, our portfolio consists of two

category-leading brands: one in First Aid & Emergency Preparedness and the other in Travel Accessories.

Both brands operate under a single Seller Central account, presenting significant opportunities for catalog

expansion, advertising efficiency, and cross-merchandising.



In this role, you are not simply managing listings. You are the primary owner of the channel’s P&L. You will

make high-stakes executive decisions backed by financial rigor, driving profitable top-line and bottom-line

expansion. You will orchestrate advertising strategy, listing conversion optimization, promotional calendars,

external traffic capture, and strategic relationships (including our Amazon SAS Core partner).



******** KEY RESPONSIBILITIES********



1. P&L Ownership & Financial Leadership

• Commercial Accountability: Own the Amazon channel P&L end-to-end, steering margin health,

revenue velocity, and net contribution.

• Cost & Margin Decomposition: Deeply analyze unit economics, Landed COGS, Amazon fee

structures (FBA fulfillment, referral, storage, aged inventory surcharges), and overall contribution margin

to inform pricing and operational decisions.

• Capital & TACoS Allocation: Determine and allocate target TACoS (Total Advertising Cost of Sales)

percentage points across specific product lines and ad formats to maintain healthy profitability while

unlocking incremental growth.



2. Advertising Strategy & External Traffic Leverage

• PPC Team Collaboration: Partner closely with our internal PPC Manager to execute high-performing

ad campaigns across all inventory formats:

• Sponsored Products (SP)

• Sponsored Brands (SB)

• Sponsored Brand Video (SBV)

• Sponsored Display (SD)

• TACoS Discipline: Ensure campaign efficiency aligns strictly with overarching P&L margin targets and

inventory lifecycle stages.

• External Traffic & Spillover Synergy: Quantify and leverage halo traffic originating from our

direct-to-consumer (Shopify) marketing channels. Devise strategies to capture, attribute, and accelerate

this external demand to boost Amazon organic rank and BSR velocity.



3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Listing Architecture

• Systematic CRO Audits: Regularly audit existing product detail pages (PDPs) across both brand

catalogs to identify friction points and conversion leakage.

• Hypothesis-Driven Testing: Develop structured CRO hypotheses for creative assets, infographics,

Premium A+ Content, copy, and video.

• Creative Collaboration: Partner with our Creative Designer to produce conversion-optimized creative

assets based on your strategic briefs.

• A/B Experimentation: Design, execute, and monitor iterative A/B tests (via Amazon Manage Your

Experiments and third-party tooling) to systematically identify winning listing iterations that maximize

conversion rate and session value.

• Search Query Performance (SQP) Optimization: Utilize Amazon SQP and Brand Analytics data to

reverse-engineer customer search intent, refining titles, bullet points, backend search terms, and

descriptions for organic dominance.



4. Merchandising, Cross-Selling & Promotional Strategy

• Parent/Child ASIN Architecture: Capitalize on our high-performing cross-selling parent ASIN

structures to maximize basket size, customer lifetime value, and cross-brand discovery.

• Deal Cadence & Execution: Plan, schedule, and execute high-impact promotional events, including

7-Day / Best Deals and Prime Exclusive Deals (PEDs).

• Deal Post-Mortems: Rigorously evaluate every promotional event to assess whether it delivered

genuine incremental velocity while safeguarding net contribution margins.

• Amazon Storefront Optimization: Continuously evaluate Storefront performance and landing page

entry points. Optimize brand narrative, user navigation, and the path to purchase to reduce bounce rates

and maximize average order value (AOV).



5. Technical Operations & Strategic Escalations

• Catalog Health & Compliance: Work in tandem with our Amazon Technical Specialist to proactively

maintain account health, resolve listing suppressions, remediate stranded inventory, and expedite case

resolution.

• Amazon SAS Core Management: Serve as the primary operational and strategic liaison with our

dedicated Amazon SAS Core representative, leveraging this relationship for new beta programs,

commercial growth opportunities, and critical issue escalations.





********CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS********



**Required Experience:**



1.) High-Volume Track Record: 5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central management, with proven

success steering high-volume, 8-figure accounts ($10M to $20M+ annual run rate).



2.) P&L Fluency: Thorough understanding of e-commerce financial models, contribution margin analysis,

fee structures, and TACoS/ROAS balance.



3.) Advanced Amazon Tooling: Mastery of Amazon Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance (SQP),

Manage Your Experiments, Category Insight reports, and the full Amazon Ads console.



4.) Analytical & Data-Driven: Exceptional analytical capability with advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills;

ability to turn granular marketplace data into decisive commercial action.



5.) Strategic CRO Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing creative briefs, formulating conversion

hypotheses, and executing split-testing protocols.



6.) Autonomous Leadership: Executive presence and proactive mindset capable of managing

cross-functional contributors (PPC specialists, technical support, creative designers).



**Preferred Qualifications**

1.) Direct experience in consumer physical products within the Emergency Preparedness / First Aid or

Travel Gear / Accessories categories.

2.) Familiarity with omni-channel dynamics, specifically the interaction between Shopify D2C advertising

and Amazon organic lift.

3.) Experience managing Amazon SAS Core or equivalent dedicated account management programs.



********HOW TO APPLY********

To apply, please submit:



1.) Links to your Updated Resume & Portfolio

2.) A brief Cover Note or Loom Video addressing:

- The annual revenue scale of the largest Amazon Seller Central account you have personally managed.

- How you approach calculating and managing TACoS allocation across Sponsored Products, Sponsored

Brands, and Sponsored Display within a strict P&L framework.

- One specific example of a successful listing CRO experiment or promotional strategy you designed and

scaled on Amazon.



******COMPENSATION & BENEFITS******



• Base Salary: $3,500 to $5,000 USD per month, commensurate with experience and past scale

managed.

• Performance Bonus: Aggressive annual cash bonus tied directly to hitting clear, pre-agreed P&L and

growth KPIs.

• Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Distributed team.

• Impact & Ownership: High degree of executive autonomy over a substantial, mature $20M business

line with direct exposure to brand leadership.



WE CAN’T WAIT TO REVIEW YOUR APPLICATION AND DISCUSS HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOUR STRATEGIC VISION! 🏆🔥

description:
IMPORTANT NOTICE TO APPLICANTS

E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

MORALVE | JOB DESCRIPTION

Department: E-commerce Operations | Reports To: Operations & Supply Chain Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time | Work Arrangement: Remote



POSITION OVERVIEW

MORALVE is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and proactive E-commerce Operations Assistant to support the daily operations of our growing e-commerce business.



This versatile, hands-on role covers marketplace and account health monitoring, inventory tracking, customer service, logistics coordination, data entry, administrative support, and ongoing system and database maintenance.



The primary purpose is to ensure daily operations run smoothly, information remains accurate and current, and recurring tasks are monitored, documented, and completed. The assistant works closely with the Operations & Supply Chain Manager across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.



We value reliability, initiative, follow-through, adaptability, and willingness to learn as much as previous technical experience. As familiarity develops, the role can progress from task execution toward independent ownership of routine workflows, exception identification, and project coordination.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketplace Account Monitoring & Maintenance

• Perform daily and recurring checks across Amazon and other assigned marketplaces.

• Monitor account health, notifications, alerts, warnings, and pending action items.



2. Inventory Monitoring & Maintenance

• Monitor inventory availability and stock health across marketplaces and inventory systems.

• Track replenishments, transfers, inbound activity, and receiving updates.

• Update inventory trackers and compare internal data against marketplace records.



3. Customer Service & Customer Experience Support

• Monitor and respond to routine customer inquiries using established guidelines and templates.

• Support order inquiries, delivery concerns, returns, refunds, and replacements within approved authority.

• Track unresolved cases, document actions, and follow up to closure.

• Identify recurring product or service issues and escalate sensitive or nonstandard cases.



4. Logistics, Shipment & Order Monitoring

• Monitor shipment and logistics updates, communications, and operational notifications.

• Maintain shipment trackers and milestones, including estimated arrival, delivery, and receiving.

• Assist with Amazon FBA, AWD, and other marketplace inbound monitoring.

• Record shipment references and organize supporting documents.

• Follow up on missing routine updates and flag delays or discrepancies.



5. Purchase Order & Supplier Coordination Support

• Maintain purchase order records, production updates, and related tracking systems.

• Monitor supplier communications, completion dates, inspection updates, and outstanding information.

• Collect quotations, documents, and routine supplier information.



6. Data Entry, Database & Tracker Maintenance

• Perform accurate recurring data entry and maintenance in spreadsheets, trackers, and databases.

• Update records using verified
s, reports, marketplace information, and supplier communications.

• Identify duplicate, missing, outdated, or inconsistent data.

• Assist with historical backtracking, cleanup, cross-checking, and reconciliation.

• Follow established data standards, formatting, and naming conventions.



7.
, Communication & Task Management

• Monitor assigned operational inboxes and channels; categorize and label communications.

• Identify and execute routine actions, follow-ups, documentation, and escalation.

• Track outstanding requests and pending responses.

• Communicate updates to internal and external stakeholders as appropriate.



8. Document & File Organization

• Download, rename, categorize, and store operational files according to company standards.

• Organize product, shipment, purchase order, inspection, supplier, and customer service documents.

• Support historical file cleanup and ensure records are traceable to their transactions.



9. Routine Operational & Administrative Support

• Complete assigned daily, weekly, and monthly checklists and maintenance tasks.

• Assist with account checks, reporting, data collection, research, and administrative activities.

• Support routine coordination across departments and evolving business needs.



10. Project Coordination & Process Improvement

• Maintain assigned project boards, task lists, deadlines, and documentation.

• Track deliverables, follow up on action items, and report blockers early.

• Assist with small operational projects and SOP documentation.

• Suggest practical improvements to accuracy, organization, and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Experience in at least 3 areas: : e-commerce operations, virtual assistance, administrative support, customer service, marketplace management, inventory/order management, logistics support, or data entry.

• Working knowledge of Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, sorting, filtering, and organizing data.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, written and verbal English communication.

• Ability to interpret
s, spreadsheets, reports, and operational systems and determine routine next steps.

• Ability to manage recurring responsibilities, follow SOPs, and work independently in a remote environment.

• Reliability, accountability, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn.



Preferred

• Experience with Amazon Seller Central or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with marketplace account health, listings, inventory, orders, and e-commerce customer service.

• Experience with Google Workspace and project tools such as 
, ClickUp, Asana, or Notion.

• Basic familiarity with Amazon FBA/AWD, shipments, purchase orders, and replenishment.

• Experience working with suppliers or logistics providers and maintaining SOPs or operational trackers.



KEY COMPETENCIES

Attention to Detail - Maintains accurate records and recognizes inconsistencies.

Reliability & Consistency - Completes recurring responsibilities on time.

Ownership & Accountability - Takes responsibility and follows tasks to completion.

Proactiveness - Identifies missing information, pending actions, and potential issues.

Problem-Solving - Investigates and proposes possible solutions before escalation.

Learning Agility - Learns new tools and processes quickly.

Organization & Prioritization - Distinguishes urgent issues from routine tasks.

Communication & Follow-Through - Provides timely updates and closes loops.

Adaptability - Supports changing needs across operational functions.

Process Discipline & Judgment - Follows SOPs and recognizes when approval is required.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

• Complete daily, weekly, and monthly responsibilities accurately and on time.

• Keep operational records complete, consistent, and up to date.

• Identify and report marketplace, inventory, customer service, and logistics issues promptly.

• Track open inquiries and action items through resolution.

• Communicate progress, challenges, and blockers proactively.

• Gradually manage assigned recurring workflows with less supervision.



WORK SCHEDULE & BENEFITS

Work Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Work Arrangement: Remote

13th Month Pay: Provided annually

Paid Holidays: Paid Philippine Regular and Special Non-Working Holidays

Paid Time Off (PTO): 5 paid leave days per year

Team Environment: Collaborative and supportive remote team

Professional Growth: Hands-on exposure to e-commerce tools and operations



GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

Initially, the role focuses on learning MORALVE's systems, completing recurring tasks accurately, and maintaining reliable records. With demonstrated consistency, accountability, and judgment, the assistant may progress toward independent ownership of operational processes, advanced marketplace and inventory responsibilities, reporting and reconciliation, workflow improvement, and cross-functional project coordination.





If these resonate with you, we’d love to hear from you!

We recommend setting aside enough time to complete everything in one go. Please read the instructions carefully and make sure all required information is submitted.



Having trouble accessing the form? Feel free to
 us at 
 and we'll be happy to assist.



Thank you for your interest in joining MORALVE! We appreciate the time and effort you're putting into your application and look forward to learning more about you.

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer & Creative Strategist (Lifestyle/Vlogs)
description:
Hi! I'm looking for an incredibly talented YouTube thumbnail designer who genuinely lives and breathes YouTube!



I'm not looking for someone who simply knows Photoshop or Canva. I want someone who understands YouTube psychology, storytelling, click-through rates (CTR), and what makes someone stop scrolling and actually click on a video.



Ideally, you've worked with successful YouTube channels, understand what makes videos perform, and have an exceptional eye for design.



**HOW WE'LL WORK TOGETHER**



I'll send you my completed YouTube video (typically 20–30 minutes), and from there, I want you to take the creative lead.



Your job will be to:

- Watch the video and understand the story, message, and most interesting moments.

- Identify the strongest hook or angle that would make someone want to watch.

- Come up with a compelling thumbnail concept that creates curiosity + clickbait (but in a good way).

- Design a beautiful, professional thumbnail that fits my channel's aesthetic.

- Bonus points if you can recommend strong YouTube titles that complement your thumbnail!



I don't want to have to explain exactly what to design every time. I'm looking for someone who can bring their own ideas, creative instincts, and expertise to the table.



**THE AESTHETIC**



My channel is a lifestyle channel focused on cozy living, home, routines, personal growth, and everyday vlogs.



I'm drawn to thumbnails that feel:

- Editorial, elevated, and Pinterest-worthy

- Beautifully composed with natural colors and cohesive color grading

- Creative with collages, photo cutouts, layering, and typography

- Personal, relatable, and visually interesting

- Aesthetically pleasing while still optimized for clicks

- Grabs your attention immediately



I'll provide examples of thumbnails I love so you can understand the creative direction.



**WHO I'M LOOKING FOR**




 (PLEASE OPEN)



- Someone who genuinely LOVES YouTube and studies successful channels.

- Proven experience designing thumbnails for successful YouTubers.

- A deep understanding of CTR, audience psychology, visual storytelling, and thumbnail strategy.

- Exceptional Photoshop, photo manipulation, and compositing skills.

- Someone who understands lifestyle, vlog, home, and personal-brand content.

- Someone who can turn ordinary footage into an irresistible thumbnail.

- Strong creative instincts and the confidence to pitch their own ideas.

- Reliable communication and turnaround times.



**TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE:**



1. Your portfolio featuring your 5 best YouTube thumbnails.

2. Links to YouTube channels you've worked with, especially successful channels. Tell me what you contributed.

3. Have any of your thumbnails achieved impressive CTRs or helped videos outperform? I'd love to see examples!

4. Who are your 3 favorite YouTube creators when it comes to thumbnails, and why?

5. If I sent you a 20-minute lifestyle vlog without any direction, how would you figure out the best thumbnail?

6. Are you comfortable suggesting YouTube titles as well?

7. What is your rate per thumbnail?



**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**



This is a paid, per-thumbnail opportunity with the potential for consistent, long-term work. ($5 for trial and $10-$15 per thumbnail if hired)



I'm looking for a creative partner who gets genuinely excited about YouTube, cares about the details, and wants to help build something successful.



If you're someone who analyzes YouTube thumbnails for fun and understands both the creative and strategic side of making videos successful, I'd love to hear from you!

title: Remote Market Manager – MaidPro
description:
# MaidPro Market Manager



## About the Role



MaidPro is looking for an organized, dependable, and proactive Market Manager to help manage daily branch operations and support our cleaning professionals (“Pros”).



The role focuses on managing assigned Pros, keeping schedules organized, addressing staffing needs, handling customer concerns, and making sure daily jobs are properly completed in our system.



You will also assist with recruiting when needed, contacting new leads, preparing cleaning estimates, and booking new customers.



We are looking for someone with relevant experience who can work independently, communicate clearly, solve problems, and follow MaidPro procedures.



## Key Responsibilities



**1. Daily Operations & Scheduling**

- Manage daily schedules, job assignments, and Pro availability.

- Address call-offs, scheduling conflicts, and staffing issues.

- Help prepare upcoming schedules and ensure jobs are assigned properly.

- Monitor daily job progress and follow up on outstanding jobs.

- Close completed jobs in MaidPro's system by verifying the job status, checking that required information is recorded, and updating the job as completed once the service has been finished.

- Follow up on jobs that remain open or incomplete to ensure records are accurate and daily reports reflect completed work.

- Maintain accurate job records and complete assigned daily reports.



**2. Pro Management & Recruiting**

- Communicate with assigned Pros/cleaner about schedules, availability, and job-related concerns.

- Monitor attendance and help address performance or compliance issues.

- Recruit and interview additional Pros/cleaner when staffing needs arise.

- Assist with onboarding and provide new hires with the necessary information.

- Coordinate staffing concerns with leadership.



**3. Customer Service & Quality Control**

- Respond to customer concerns about cleaning quality, missed tasks, scheduling, and completed services.

- Review job notes, cleaning photos, and account information to understand concerns.

- Coordinate re-cleans or other appropriate solutions when needed.

- Follow up with customers and document issues and resolutions.

- Help ensure Pros follow MaidPro's cleaning standards and procedures.



**4. Sales & Customer Bookings**

- Make outbound calls to new leads and follow up with prospective customers.

- Understand customer needs and explain MaidPro's cleaning services.

- Follow up on pending estimates and open leads.

- Follow MaidPro procedures and ensure assigned tasks are completed on time.



## Required Qualifications



- Previous experience in operations, scheduling, team coordination, customer service, or a similar role.

- Experience communicating with employees or managing a team.

- Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Ability to handle customer concerns professionally.

- Experience with recruiting, outbound sales calls, estimates, or appointment booking is an advantage.

- Comfortable using computer systems and learning new software.

- Ability to work independently and follow established procedures.



**Software Experience:**

- Salesforce experience is strongly preferred, especially for managing customer records, leads, and follow-ups.

- RingCentral experience is preferred for handling calls and contacting customers.

- Experience with similar CRM or phone systems is also welcome.



Experience in cleaning, home services, hospitality, or a similar industry is a plus.



## Schedule



- Full-time, Monday through Friday.

- Must be ready to work at 7:00 AM CST.

- Must be responsive during working hours and able to handle scheduling changes and customer concerns as they arise.



## How to Apply



Please
 your updated resume to:



To:

Include the following in your
:

- Full name and phone number

- Current location

- Confirmation of availability to work Monday through Friday starting at 7:00 AM CST

A current resume is required for consideration. Qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview. Additional interviews or assessments may be required.

Position Overview



We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and customer-focused **Sales & Estimating Coordinator** to support our Business Development and Sales operations. This role will be responsible for managing incoming inquiries, qualifying leads, preparing estimates and proposals, and maintaining consistent follow-ups to help convert prospective clients into active projects.



The ideal candidate is comfortable communicating with clients through phone calls,
, and SMS, has strong organizational and administrative skills, and can assist with sales growth initiatives and marketing material development. Knowledge of land surveying is a plus but is not required.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Lead Response & Client Communication**

- Respond promptly to incoming inquiries from Thumbtack, RingCentral, 
, and other lead sources through calls,
s, and SMS.

- Contact prospective clients to gather essential project information, including property address, contact details, survey purpose, and project requirements.

- Qualify leads and determine the appropriate information needed before preparing estimates.



**2. Estimating & Proposal Preparation**

- Prepare accurate cost estimates and formal quotes for residential and small commercial surveying projects.

- Coordinate with the appropriate team members when additional project information or technical input is needed.

- Ensure proposals are complete, accurate, and submitted within established turnaround times.



**3. Mapping & GIS Support**

- Use Google Earth to outline property boundaries, identify site locations, and define preliminary project limits.

- Gather relevant mapping information to support project scoping and estimating.



**4. Compliance & Project Requirements**

- Research and review applicable city and municipal surveying regulations.

- Ensure estimates and proposals account for relevant local requirements and project-specific considerations.



**5. Sales Pipeline Management & Follow-Ups**

- Maintain consistent follow-ups with prospective clients, active leads, and pending quotes.

- Monitor the sales pipeline and proactively engage clients to help move opportunities toward approval and signature.

- Keep lead records and sales activity updated and organized.



### Additional Responsibilities



**6. Sales Growth & Marketing Support**

- Assist in developing and implementing strategies to generate new leads and improve quote approval rates.

- Participate in sales and marketing initiatives to increase client engagement and business opportunities.

- Assist in creating marketing materials, presentations, and other promotional content.



**7. Lead Tracking & Reporting**

- Track and monitor incoming lead volume across various platforms.

- Maintain lead activity records and provide updates on lead status, quote conversions, and follow-up progress.



**8. Client Reviews & Job Tracking**

- Follow up with clients to encourage Google and Thumbtack reviews upon project completion.

- Request the weekly completed job list from Bernadette every Thursday to support client review follow-ups.



**9. Team Support**

- Provide administrative and operational support to the Business Development and Sales teams.

- Assist with special assignments, sales initiatives, and other ad-hoc projects as needed.



### Qualifications & Requirements



- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

- Comfortable making outbound calls and communicating with prospective and existing clients.

- Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to prepare estimates, manage multiple inquiries, and meet deadlines.

- Proficiency in Google Earth, Microsoft Office, and other basic business productivity tools.

- Ability to create or assist in developing marketing materials and presentations.

- Proactive, resourceful, and capable of working independently while collaborating with a team.



**Preferred Qualifications (Not Required):**

- Previous experience in sales coordination, estimating, lead generation, or customer service.

- Familiarity with land surveying, civil engineering, construction, or related industries.

- Basic understanding of property boundaries, survey types, and surveying terminology.

- Experience with CRM systems and lead management platforms.

- Basic graphic design skills or familiarity with Canva or similar tools.



What We’re Looking For



We are seeking someone who takes ownership of incoming opportunities, communicates confidently with clients, and understands the importance of timely responses and consistent follow-ups. The successful candidate will play an important role in strengthening our sales pipeline, improving client experience, and supporting the company's continued growth.



**Land surveying experience is a plus, not a requirement. We are open to candidates who are willing to learn the industry and develop their technical knowledge on the job.**

title: UGC & Trybe Creator Manager
description:
**Brand:** Movira  

**Role:** UGC & Creator Tribe Manager  

**Type:** Remote



Movira is a growing DTC wellness brand, and we’re looking for a highly organized, proactive **UGC & Creator Tribe Manager** to take hands-on ownership of our creator community.



This is not a passive coordination role. We’re looking for someone who is **very active on TikTok and Instagram**, understands creator culture, knows how to spot people who naturally fit a brand, and genuinely enjoys building relationships with creators.



You’ll receive clear strategic guidance and have a **weekly meeting with the founder**, but you’ll be responsible for the day-to-day execution and management of the UGC pipeline.



### What you'll be doing



- Actively scout potential UGC creators on **TikTok, Trybe and Instagram**

- Identify creators who naturally match our target customers and brand aesthetic.

- Reach out to creators and manage communication from first contact through content delivery

- Build and maintain our **UGC creator trybe**

- Brief creators using guidelines and creative direction provided by us

- Coordinate product seeding and creator collaborations

- Follow up consistently to make sure content is delivered on time

- Keep track of creator status, content, deadlines, usage rights and deliverables

- Review incoming UGC and make sure it follows the brief

- Communicate feedback and request revisions when necessary

- Maintain strong relationships with our best-performing creators and encourage repeat collaborations

- Continuously look for new creator opportunities and emerging TikTok/Instagram trends

- Keep the founder updated on progress, bottlenecks and opportunities



We're looking for someone who



- Is **very active on TikTok and Instagram** and understands how content on these platforms actually works

- Has experience working with UGC creators, influencers or creator communities

- Is an excellent communicator and feels comfortable messaging creators every day

- Is proactive — you don't wait to be told to follow up

- Is highly organized and can manage many creator conversations at the same time

- Has a good eye for identifying creators who feel authentic rather than overly polished or "ad-like"

- Understands UGC and direct-response/DTC content

- Can work independently once the direction and priorities are clear

- Is comfortable giving creators feedback in a friendly but clear way

- Speaks and writes excellent English



What success looks like



We don't want someone who simply maintains a spreadsheet of creators.



We want someone who **owns the creator pipeline**, consistently finding new talent, starting conversations, getting products into creators' hands, making sure content gets delivered, maintaining relationships, and helping us build a reliable network of creators we can work with repeatedly.



You'll have guidance, briefs and strategic direction from us, including a **weekly session with the founder**, but we're specifically looking for someone who can take that direction and run with it during the week.



To apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your experience with UGC/influencer management.

2. Links to any brands or creator programs you've previously worked with.

3. Your personal TikTok/Instagram or examples showing that you're genuinely familiar with these platforms.

4. Tell us how you would find **20 potential UGC creators for a women's wellness brand in the US**.

5. Your availability and expected monthly compensation.



**Bonus:** Send us 3 TikTok or Instagram creators you think could be a good fit for Movira and briefly explain why you chose them.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a genuine part of the brand and help us build a strong creator community, not simply complete assigned tasks.

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Industry:** Research Peptides / Online Pharmacy  

**Opportunity:** Long-term position with growth opportunities after 90 days



## About the Position



We are looking for a motivated, resourceful, and detail-oriented **Virtual Assistant** to help manage the digital marketing and research activities of our peptide and online pharmacy websites.



This is a diverse role where no two days will be exactly the same. You'll be involved in SEO, link building, competitor research, affiliate outreach, social media, and general website-related projects.



**We are looking for someone who takes initiative, works independently, and knows how to get things done without constant supervision.**



Training and guidance will be provided, but previous experience with SEO link building is required.



## Key Responsibilities



**SEO & Link Building**

- Research and identify quality backlink opportunities.

- Evaluate websites based on relevance, organic traffic, and authority.

- Conduct outreach to website owners and publishers.

- Track acquired backlinks and maintain organized reports.

- Research competitors' backlinks and identify opportunities.



**Research & Reporting**

- Prepare clear, organized reports using Google Sheets or Excel.

- Identify opportunities to improve website traffic and online visibility.



**Affiliate Outreach**

- Research potential affiliates and marketing partners.

- Contact prospective affiliates and introduce our programs.

- Maintain outreach records and follow up with interested partners.

- Help identify opportunities to grow our affiliate network.



**Social Media Management**

- Schedule social media posts across various platforms.

- Assist with content calendars and post preparation.

- Research trending topics and content opportunities.

- Use AI tools to assist with captions, graphics, and content ideas.



**Other Responsibilities**

- Assist with occasional website updates and administrative tasks.

- Help maintain spreadsheets and marketing records.

- Learn new tools and take on additional projects as needed.



## Requirements



- **Previous SEO link-building experience is required.**

- Strong online research skills.

- Good written English and communication skills.

- Experience with Google Sheets or Excel.

- Comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools to improve productivity.

- Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

- Strong initiative and willingness to learn.

- Reliable internet connection.

- Availability to work **40 hours per week**.



## Nice to Have (Not Required)



- Experience with Google Analytics (GA4).

- Experience with Google Search Console.

- Familiarity with Ahrefs or Semrush.

- WordPress experience.

- Experience with affiliate marketing or outreach.

- Basic graphic design skills using Canva or AI tools.

- Experience working with e-commerce, healthcare, or online pharmacy websites.



## Who We're Looking For



We value attitude, reliability, and initiative just as much as technical skills.



We're looking for someone who can receive a task, understand the objective, research the best approach, and deliver results.



You should be comfortable asking questions when needed, but you should also be capable of solving problems independently.



**This is not a position for someone who needs constant supervision or waits to be told what to do next.**



## Compensation & Growth



- Starting salary: **$350 USD/month**.

- Full-time: 40 hours per week.

- Remote, long-term opportunity.

- Training provided on company-specific tools and processes.

- **Performance and salary review after 90 days**, with opportunities for increased compensation and responsibilities based on performance.



We're looking for someone interested in growing with our business over the long term.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. What experience do you have with SEO link building? Describe one backlink you successfully acquired and how you obtained it.

2. How do you determine whether a website is worth pursuing for a backlink?

3. What AI tools do you regularly use, and how have they helped you complete a task?

4. Have you performed competitor research or affiliate outreach before? Please describe your experience.

5. Why are you interested in this position?

I want to hear from you personally. Please write your application in your own words, provide specific examples of your experience, and answer the questions directly.



Using AI tools on the job is encouraged, but your application should demonstrate your own communication skills, experience, and ability to think independently.

We look forward to hearing from applicants who are motivated, dependable, and ready to grow with our team.

title: Scientific Technical Support
description:
What We Offer



- Job stability: salary payments are solid and stable.

- Real professional experience in a growing biotechnology-related company based in Bolivia.

- Participation in applied technical analysis, scientific support, and product communication.

- Direct supervision and learning opportunities with the company’s General Manager and internal team.

- Opportunity to gain international work experience in Latin America.

- Intercultural experience in La Paz, Bolivia.

We are seeking a Scientific Specialist in Plant Biotechnology or related fields to support the technical work of the Plant Biotechnology Laboratory. The selected person will participate in comparative analysis of reagents and supplies, technical report writing, creation of educational audiovisual material, and customer-oriented technical support.

Extensive previous professional experience is not mandatory. We especially value scientific training, discipline, analytical thinking, academic or extracurricular achievements, clear communication, and the ability to quickly learn new methodologies, programs, and tools, including artificial intelligence tools applied to scientific and documentation work.
