- Analyze technical sheets, specifications, and scientific documentation to prepare clear and useful comparative tables.

- Write technical reports on results, product differences, advantages, limitations, and possible applications.

- Support activities of the Plant Biotechnology Laboratory related to phytopathology, molecular biology, plant biotechnology, and related areas.

- Document tests and procedures through videos, photographs, guides, or audiovisual material that can serve as technical evidence and educational content for clients.

- Prepare explanatory material for technical training, and post-sale support.

- Provide continuous technical support, helping answer client questions regarding product use, performance, and applications.

- Use digital and artificial intelligence tools to improve document review, technical analysis, report writing, and production of support materials.



Recommended Academic Background

We’re seeking candidates from the following or related areas:



- Biotechnology Engineering

- Plant Biotechnology

- Agronomy

- Biochemistry

- Molecular Biology

- Phytopathology

- Microbiology

- Biology

- Agricultural sciences or related scientific fields



Valued Knowledge



- Phytopathology.

- Molecular biology.

- Plant biotechnology.

- Basic laboratory work.

- Interpretation of technical sheets, protocols, and scientific documentation.

- Technical report writing.

- Scientific communication and preparation of educational material.

- Use of digital tools, spreadsheets, analysis tools, and artificial intelligence tools.



Required Profile



- Good level of English.

- Strong motivation for applied scientific work and continuous learning.

- Analytical ability to compare products, interpret technical information, and propose clear conclusions.

- Responsibility, discipline, organization, and attention to detail.

- Strong oral and written communication skills to explain technical information clearly.

- Customer-oriented mindset and willingness to provide technical support.

- Willingness to create simple, useful, and educational audiovisual material.

- Ability to adapt to new methodologies, tools, and work processes.

- Interest in working in an international and intercultural environment.



Valued Qualifications



- Specialization or focused training in Plant Pathology is desirable but is not required to apply.



- Outstanding academic profile or academic record, ideally above 80 points over 100 or equivalent (estimated in 2,5).

- Recognition in academic, scientific, sports, artistic, entrepreneurial, or extracurricular areas.

- Strong academic background from school or high school.

- Participation in research projects, laboratory work, science fairs, competitions, publications, teaching assistant roles, or technical activities.

- Interest in combining science, technical communication, customer support, and innovation.



About MaxPrecision Lab



MaxPrecision Lab S.R.L. is a biotechnology-related company based in La Paz, Bolivia, dedicated to the distribution of laboratory materials, supplies, reagents, and specialized products. We are looking for international talent with a scientific profile, strong learning ability, and motivation to join a growing company and contribute to real projects involving technical analysis, product validation, scientific support, and applied communication.

title: Customer Service VA for Clothing Brand - must have worked for a clothing brand on Shopify
description:
Hi! We run a streetwear and hikewear clothing brand - jackets and tracksuits

mainly. We're looking for one person to take over the customer side of the brand

so it stops landing on us.



This is a long-term role. We want someone who is still here in a year, not

someone filling a gap for a month.



THE WORK

- Answer customer
s and Instagram/TikTok DMs. Sizing, shipping, order

  status, address changes, cancellations, exchanges.

- Reply to comments on our posts within a day, reply to anyone who tags us, and

  answer the "how much" and "where do I buy this" comments with the current

  offer. We give you the exact lines.

- Chase delivery problems with the courier until they're actually resolved, and

  keep the customer updated while you do it.

- Product work in Shopify: build and tidy listings (title, description, sizes,

  variants, pricing, SEO), resize and upload images, set up pre-orders on drops,

  keep stock accurate, discount codes, fulfil orders and add tracking.

- Ask for reviews after delivery, issue the credit code, reply to every review.

- Keep one shared sheet of anything you couldn't resolve, so nothing goes quiet.



You will get scripted lines from us for the common situations, and a clear rule

for what you can d
 on your own versus what you send to us. We would much

rather you ask than guess.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU (please read this part properly)

- YOU MUST HAVE WORKED FOR A CLOTHING OR APPAREL BRAND BEFORE. Not e-commerce in

  general. Sizing questions, exchanges, fit complaints and "does this run small"

  are most of this job, and clothing is the only place you learn to answer them.

- YOU MUST HAVE WORKED IN SHOPIFY, on a real store with real orders. Name the

  store and say what you actually did in it - orders, listings, or both. We need

  someone who can build a product page, not only answer messages.

- SEND US 3 REAL REPLIES YOU HAVE WRITTEN TO CUSTOMERS. Copy and paste them

  straight into your application. Remove the customer's name. One of them should

  be a complaint or a problem order - we want to see how you handle someone

  who's annoyed, not just an easy question.

- EXCELLENT WRITTEN ENGLISH. Every task above is a message a customer reads with

  our name on it.

- Experience replying to comments and DMs as a brand, not from a personal

  account. Say which brand's social accounts you handled.

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to work. No shared or cafe connections.

- You can commit to the same hours every weekday.



WHAT WE DON'T NEED

- A team or an agency. We're hiring one person directly.

- Phone support, cold outreach or appointment setting experience. Different job.

- Someone who needs a script for everything. The scripts cover the common cases;

  the rest needs judgement.

- Anyone who will use AI to write customer replies for us. We can tell, and the

  customers can tell. Write like a person.



HOURS AND PAY

Around 15-20 hours a week to start, spread across weekdays, long-term, with more

hours available as we grow. Paid weekly.

$3-5 USD/hour depending on your experience, reviewed after the first month.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your reply with the word COMPASS so we know you read this.



Then send us:

1. The clothing brand you did customer service for, and for how long

2. The Shopify store you worked in, and what you did in it

3. The 3 real customer replies you have written (paste them in, one a complaint)

4. Which brand's social accounts you replied to comments and DMs on

5. What hours you can work, in your local time, and your time zone

6. Your WhatsApp number

title: YouTube Video Editor | Storytelling, Lifestyle & Cinematic Vlogs
description:
Creative YouTube Video Editor (Long-Term Opportunity)



I'm a lifestyle and home content creator looking for an exceptionally talented YouTube video editor to help bring my creative vision to life.



I'm not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together, adds transitions, and calls it a day. I'm looking for someone who genuinely **understands YouTube, loves storytelling, has incredible attention to detail, and knows how to make ordinary moments feel interesting and beautiful.**



This is an opportunity to grow alongside a creator and help build a YouTube channel from the ground up, with the potential for a long-term working relationship.



### The Creative Style



Please familiarize yourself with these YouTube creators before applying:



- Victoria Morse

- Alex Nicoll



I'm drawn to their thoughtful storytelling, beautiful visuals, natural pacing, personality, and ability to make everyday life engaging.



My content will focus on cozy minimalist living, home, lifestyle, routines, organization, creativity, and personal experiences.



The goal is to create videos that feel cinematic yet authentic, aesthetically beautiful without being overproduced, and personal without feeling forced.



### What I'm Looking For



**You MUST have previous experience editing long-form YouTube videos.**



Ideally, you're someone who:



- Understands storytelling, narrative structure, pacing, and audience retention.

- Knows how to create compelling openings that make viewers want to keep watching.

- Has an excellent eye for color grading, natural lighting, composition, and visual consistency.

- Can create smooth, intentional edits without relying on excessive transitions or effects.

- Understands music selection, sound design, ambient audio, and how sound contributes to emotion.

- Can identify the strongest moments in raw footage and build a cohesive story around them.

- Understands YouTube culture, current editing styles, and what makes videos successful.

- Can incorporate tasteful typography, subtle graphics, B-roll, and creative transitions when appropriate.

- Understands the difference between TikTok editing and long-form YouTube storytelling.

- Is comfortable editing lifestyle, home, vlog, and personality-driven content.

- Has a strong creative perspective and isn't afraid to suggest improvements.

- Has excellent attention to detail and can maintain consistency across videos.

- Is fluent in written and spoken English and can confidently understand conversational American English, humor, and cultural references.

- Is dependable, organized, communicative, and receptive to feedback.



**Most importantly, I want someone who goes the extra mile.**



Someone who notices when a scene could use better sound design, when an introduction isn't compelling enough, or when changing the sequence of clips could make the story significantly stronger.



I want a creative collaborator, not just someone following instructions.



### Your Responsibilities



- Edit engaging, polished long-form YouTube videos.

- Review raw footage and identify the strongest story.

- Develop compelling hooks, thoughtful pacing, and satisfying endings.

- Perform professional color correction and color grading.

- Source appropriate licensed or royalty-free music and sound effects.

- Incorporate tasteful B-roll, text, graphics, and transitions.

- Ensure consistent audio levels and polished sound.

- Make creative suggestions to improve storytelling and viewer retention.

- Deliver organized files and completed videos on schedule.

- Collaborate on revisions and continuously improve the editing style.



Bonus if you understand YouTube analytics, audience retention graphs, thumbnail strategy, and how editing decisions impact watch time.



### Software & Experience



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro is welcome.



I'm much more interested in your storytelling ability, editing taste, and past work than the specific software you use.



### How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. **Your portfolio:** Share 2 to 3 long-form YouTube videos you've personally edited. Clearly explain your role in each project.

2. **Your YouTube taste:** Who are your 3 favorite YouTube creators to watch, and what do you appreciate about their editing or storytelling?

3. **Your creative perspective:** Watch content from Victoria Morse, Alex Nicoll, or Alisson Baek. Tell me what you notice about their editing style and how you would approach creating something with a similar feeling while developing an original identity for my channel.

4. **Your storytelling process:** How do you turn raw footage without a script into an engaging YouTube video?

5. **Your experience:** How many years have you been editing YouTube videos, and which editing software do you use?

6. **Your availability and rate:** Please share your current availability, expected compensation, and typical turnaround time for a 25-30+ minute YouTube video.



Please begin your application with the words **"Sunday Storyteller"** so I know you've read the full description.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid editing test.



### The Opportunity



I'm looking for someone I can build a lasting creative partnership with.



As the channel grows, I'd love for this person to become increasingly involved in shaping its visual identity, storytelling approach, and overall creative direction.



If you genuinely love YouTube, have exceptional creative instincts, and take pride in making every video better than expected, I'd love to see your work.

We'll share specific schedule expectations during the interview process. Ideally we need 2 individuals to support US night shifts and weekends (daytime in PH).



ABOUT TERN

Tern is a venture-backed software company on a mission to reshape the $127B travel agency industry by giving power back to the entrepreneurs who built it. Nearly 98% of travel agencies are small businesses. These businesses have been chronically

underserved by technology. We're here to change that. Our platform helps travel advisors run more efficient, professional, and profitable operations giving them the modern infrastructure they need to lead the next chapter of travel. But the impact goes beyond business. Travel advisors help clients move more intentionally through the world. When a traveler works with an advisor, they're more likely to avoid overtouristed hotspots and more likely to spend their dollars in places where they can do real good. That's the kind of travel we want more of. At Tern, we believe in small business. We believe in the power of travel. And we're building the future of both.



Support Specialist

The support team at Tern is the foundation that determines whether our advisors and agencies

succeed on the platform. Most support orgs at this scale are still reacting and focusing support

solely on the queue. More tickets, more headcount, repeat. Tern is different. AI is embedded into

almost every single workflow as a force multiplier for our human team and it's most critical on

the support function. And, with AI supporting the majority of our customer service volume, our

expert team of ICs can be deployed elsewhere where the human touch really matters. If you’re

looking to be at the forefront of our mission to empower travel advisors with innovative

technology, making their work more efficient and their impact more significant, and equally help

define what our support org will look like long term, this role is for you. You will provide top-tier

support to our partners, troubleshoot technical issues, become an expert in our product and AI

capabilities, and collaborate closely with our product and engineering teams.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Customer Support: Be a champion for our customers, representing their needs within Tern and ensuring their voices are heard by providing prompt, professional, and effective support to travel advisors, resolving issues and ensuring their success with Tern's solutions primarily through chat, phone, and 1:1's.

- Technical Troubleshooting: Identify, diagnose, and resolve technical problems, providing expert guidance and clear communication

- Product Mastery: You are quick to learn and navigate complex technology platforms, and you enjoy staying ahead of the curve. You'll become a Tern product expert, using your knowledge to assist customers and provide valuable feedback to our internal

teams.

- Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain clear, comprehensive support documentation to help users find answers quickly

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering to surface relevant feedback on our offerings and ensure customer feedback is incorporated into our roadmap

- Continuous Improvement with AI: Build and deploy ways to enhance our support processes and overall customer experience to be improved, using AI and automation tooling to improve your personal productivity as well as the team’s



WHAT YOU HAVE

-Customer-obsession: You genuinely care about making life easier for our users and are committed to learning about our users, product, and team in depth to make that possible. You'll be the frontline voice of our customers- your problem solving and insights will directly influence product development and customer retention

-Customer phone calls: You're experienced taking customer phone calls in high-pressure/time-sensitive situations, know how to de-escalate, can multitask to find information

- Previous travel industry experience: Whether you've worked for an online travel

agency, have been or are a travel advisor 

-Technical curiosity and strong communication: While you don't need to be an engineer, familiarity with APIs, AI, and automation tools is a big plus. Even if you don’t know how to use each of these resources, you’re willing and eager to dig in. You can translate technical concepts into easy-to-understand language for non-technical users.

- User-facing enablement: You’re just as comfortable in the queue as you are creating a walk through video or hosting a live 1-1 training to close the ticket. You deploy the right lever for the right problems to resolve issues quickly and effectively.

-A fast learner: You pick up new tools, concepts, and workflows quickly, and you thrive in fast-moving, high-energy environments. You know how to approach becoming an expert in our product quickly, understanding both the technical and strategic ways advisors use it.

-Startup mindset: You're scrappy, adaptable, and ready to figure things out. You thrive on solving problems and are known for your attention to detail. You are comfortable in a fast-paced environment and can easily shift priorities as needed.



NICE-TO-HAVE

-Travel enthusiast: A love for travel is a plus; understanding the travel industry helps you connect with our customers on a deeper level. Having professional experience in the industry is a huge plus.

-Proficiency in support automations: You have the reps and excitement to build smarter workflows, leverage AI, and create self-service solutions to make support faster and more efficient

-Experience in SaaS support: Prior customer support experience is preferred, but we care more about raw talent and drive than years of experience.



WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT TERN

-Growth potential: Our team has an outsized impact at a quickly scaling company. This is your chance to get in early, grow fast, and learn.

-Work with the best: Join a team of top-tier engineers, designers, and operators building the future of travel tech

-Make an impact: Your work will directly shape the experience of thousands of travel advisors and their clients

Be a part of the hustle: Expect to wear multiple hats, learn quickly, and embrace the fast-paced nature of startup life



BONUS POINTS

-Experience providing technical or phone support for SaaS applications, preferably experience with Tern

-Experience in the travel industry

-Experience with Tern's primary tools: Intercom, Notion, Slack

-Experience utilizing AI



WHAT WE 

🌱 We're always leveling up. Whether you're deepening your craft, learning from a teammate, or embracing a new challenge, growth is core to our identity.

🧭 We act with optimistic agency. We take initiative, seek clarity, and move forward, even when the path isn't obvious. Through every peak and valley, we lead with curiosity, laughter, kindness, and resolve.

💪 We expect operational excellence. We ship value to our users every single week. We believe that compounding habits lead to sustainable productivity, consistency, and mutual trust.

Operating Principles:

👂 We deeply understand our users. At every level of the organization, we obsess about understanding those we serve and the industry we operate in.

➕ We embrace the power of and, and not now. We challenge trade-offs by asking better questions. We break hard problems into small pieces and tackle them with intention. We also know to make the hard call to say "not right now"

📣 We speak up and move forward. Everyone at Tern has a voice and a responsibility to use it. We invite healthy tension, share dissenting views early, and challenge each other with curiosity, not ego.

🧭 We move fast and sweat the details. Velocity matters and relentless progress beats perfection every time. But speed isn't chaos: we stay aligned, own our outcomes, and care deeply about quality.

🤣 We take the work seriously, but not ourselves. We hire kind, driven people who elevate the room. If you've got a big ego or take yourself too seriously, you won't last.

title: Graphic & Presentation Designer
description:
JustSimply Marketing (JSM) is a fast-scaling, fully remote marketing agency based in Ontario, Canada. We help US and Canadian personal brands grow and monetize, from content and video to launches for info products and high-ticket programs. We've worked with Danny Singson, Dr. Nae and Shaun T.



TEAM VISION

Our clients sell through their content and their presentations. The Design & Web team exists to make every carousel, post and slide deck clear, on-brand and built to convert. Designers who deliver grow with the team under the Design Director & Operations.



THE ROLE

You own daily social graphics and launch-critical slide decks for multiple personal brands. You keep each client's brand consistent across carousels, feed posts, infographics, thumbnails and simple animations. You turn rough outlines into clean, story-driven presentations for webinars, events and launches.



You report to the Design Director & Operations. You work with our Social Media, Marketing and video teams. You own quality control, and you keep Drive, templates and brand kits organized so the whole team moves faster.



WHO THIS IS FOR

You care whether a deck sells, not just whether it looks nice.

You switch between client brands without mixing them up.

Your files and folders are clean enough for anyone to use.

You'd rather build a template once than redesign the same thing ten times.

You use AI to move faster and still sweat the typography.



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

You need long timelines and loose deadlines.

You want to design only what looks good, with no link to results.

You wait to be told what to fix.



WHAT WE OFFER YOU

Fully remote contract work.

Design for high-profile personal brands like Danny Singson, Dr. Nae and Shaun T.

Launch work for info products and high-ticket programs.

A growth path inside our Design & Web team as you prove results.

Fast decisions and zero bureaucracy.



WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

Ship daily social graphics: carousels, feed posts, infographics, thumbnails and simple animations.

Keep multiple clients' brands consistent across every asset.

Build webinar, event and launch slide decks in focused 3-5 day projects.

Turn rough outlines into clean, story-driven presentations.

Build and maintain reusable templates and brand kits for each client.

Use AI tools (Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Canva AI) for hero images and faster drafts.

Own QC and keep Drive, templates and brand kits organized.

Work async in Slack and 
 with the Social Media, Marketing and video teams.



REQUIREMENTS

2+ years of graphic design, ideally for social or online brands.

A portfolio with social graphics and slide decks. Submit it with your application.

Slide design in Google Slides specifically.

Strong typography, layout and file organization.

Fluent in Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator and Google Slides.

AI-forward: hands-on with Midjourney, Firefly or similar AI image tools.

Nice to have: Figma or After Effects.



RESULTS

In your first 90 days:

Every deck project ships inside its 3-5 day window.

Each active client has an organized brand kit and template set in Drive.

Revision rounds drop as you learn each client's brand.

Daily social graphics go out on schedule with no off-brand assets.

You deliver at least 1 launch or webinar deck per month [confirm] that the client uses live.



LOCATION AND SCHEDULE

Fully remote, independent contractor.

Hours: JSM standard: 6:00 AM-2:00 PM EST (6:00 PM-2:00 AM PHT), Mon-Fri.

Daily output plus deck sprints around launches. Deadlines are fixed.



HOW WE WORK

Results over hours: output counts, not time online.

Extreme ownership: yours means yours, end to end.

High accountability, low ego: own the miss, fix it.

Growth over perfection: ship, learn, improve.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through our application form: 



Only completed forms are considered.

title: YouTube Video Editor For Documentary Channel
description:
Full-time · Salary: $650 - $850+ USD/month · Hours: 40/week



We're a YouTube studio making documentaries. Real research, real stories, no AI slop. We want every video to feel like a gripping true story, never a slideshow.



Compensation depends on your experience and skill level.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL ROLE. If you're just starting out as an editor, please don't apply.



The style we want: watch the first 3 minutes of this video (it isn't ours): 



- Mostly still images (old paintings, engravings, archive photos, maps), each brought to life with slow, varied camera moves

- Photo cut-out silhouettes, portrait cards with names, and route maps where a red line draws itself across the sea

- One colour look across the whole video, with red as the only accent

- Hard cuts timed to the narrator's breaths, not a dissolve on every shot

- A clear voice over calm, deep music, with very few sound effects



You'll:

- Turn a script, voiceover and image list into a long-form documentary

- Find and prepare the images: clean them up, cut out figures and objects, and grade them into one look

- Build the maps, cards and text animations

- Mix the voice, music and the occasional sound effect



You have:

- Long-form YouTube documentaries you edited, built mostly from still images

- Real motion-graphics skill (After Effects, Fusion or similar). You can make an old engraving feel alive without it looking like a template

- A good eye for old artwork, and the patience to find the right picture for each line



Not a fit if most of your work is short-form, talking heads, gaming, stock-footage montages or slideshow-style videos.



To apply: start your message with "RETENTION" and send:

1. 2–3 videos you edited. Do NOT send portfolio sites / links they will not be reviewed. 

2. In 1-2 sentences: Why you think you'd be a good fit for this role?

3. Your expected monthly salary



⚠️ Do NOT send portfolio sites or links to portfolios. They won't be watched, and your application won't be considered. Please only send links to the actual edited videos you'd like us to review.

title: Estimator + Project Manager (CIVIL ENGINEER)
description:

Advanced English (written and spoken).

description:
Our accounting firm is looking for someone to fully manage our social media presence on
 & Instagram plus our blog. This is a part-time, remote position of under 10 hours per week. You’ll plan, create, post, and monitor our content. You’ll work directly with the firm owner. title: Real Estate Lead Generation
description:
Real Estate Cold Caller (Foreclosure Specialist) – $7/hr + $150 Bonus per Deal | Permanent WFH



Company: Atlas Residential

Work Schedule: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (Mon–Fri) + 3 hours on Saturday (Graveyard shift in PH)

Starting Rate: $7.00/hr 

Commission: $150 per closed deal



About Atlas Residential

Atlas Residential is a North Carolina-based real estate investment company. We specialize in helping homeowners facing financial distress and foreclosure by providing them with real, ethical solutions. We are expanding our team and looking for a motivated, empathetic, and spoken-English fluent Cold Caller / Foreclosure Specialist to connect with homeowners across the US.



Why Join Us?

Competitive Compensation: Hourly USD rate + $150 deal closing bonuses.

Generous Time Off: 14 PTO days + Birthday Leave + Paid 1-week Off for Christmas!

Health & Career Perks: Health insurance reimbursement, performance-based appraisal increases, and company rewards/getaways.

100% Remote: Stable work-from-home setup—no commuting required.



Key Responsibilities

Cold Calling: Reach out to US homeowners facing potential foreclosure or distress with empathy and clarity.

Data Management: Maintain, organize, and update lead records in our CRM (Resimpli).

Multi-Channel Outreach: Execute targeted email and SMS campaigns to generate qualified leads.

Appointment Setting: Qualify interested homeowners and schedule meetings for our Acquisition Specialists.

Performance Tracking: Monitor daily call volume, connection rates, and appointment metrics to optimize conversion.



Job Requirements

Experience: At least 1 year of cold calling, outbound sales, or lead generation experience (US Real Estate or Wholesaling experience is a huge plus).

Communication: Excellent spoken and written English skills with a clean, easy-to-understand accent.

Tech Skills: Proficient with CRMs (Resimpli experience preferred, but training is provided), Google Workspace, Microsoft Excel, and web-based dialers.

Schedule: Able to work fixed US Eastern Standard Time hours (8 AM - 5 PM EST Mon-Fri + 3 hours on Saturday).

Technical System Requirements

Computer/Laptop with at least an Intel Core i3 (or AMD equivalent) and 8GB RAM.

Reliable, high-speed wired internet connection (at least 25 Mbps) with a backup connection plan.

Quiet, distraction-free home office setup.



How to Apply

If you are a driven cold caller who knows how to navigate sensitive calls with homeowners and build rapport quickly, we want to hear from you!



Please reply to this post with:

A link to your updated Resume / OnlineJobs.ph profile.

A 1-minute voice recording introducing yourself and detailing your past cold calling or real estate experience.

title: Remote Bilingual Dental Assistant
description:
NOW HIRING: BILINGUAL DENTAL VIRTUAL ASSISTANT (ENGLISH & SPANISH)



100% WORK FROM HOME | FULL-TIME | US DENTAL PRACTICE



IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT MEET ALL THE MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS LISTED BELOW WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



We are looking for a highly experienced, proactive, and detail-oriented Bilingual Dental Virtual Assistant to support a US-based dental practice.



This position is strictly for candidates with proven dental practice experience, advanced Dentrix proficiency, and fluency in both English and Spanish.



MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS



Applicants MUST meet ALL of the following requirements:



BILINGUAL – ENGLISH AND SPANISH: Must be fluent in both spoken and written English and Spanish. Chavacano is NOT a substitute for Spanish fluency.



DENTRIX EXPERT: Must have extensive hands-on experience using Dentrix Dental Practice Management Software. Basic familiarity or experience with other dental systems alone is NOT sufficient.



DENTAL PRACTICE EXPERIENCE: Must have previous professional experience working directly with a dental practice, preferably a US-based dental clinic.



PATIENT SCHEDULING EXPERTISE: Must be highly experienced in dental appointment scheduling, confirmations, rescheduling, patient follow-ups, and schedule management.



INSURANCE VERIFICATION: Must have experience verifying dental insurance eligibility and benefits, including Medicaid, private insurance, and fee-for-service arrangements.



STRONG COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Must be comfortable handling inbound patient calls, inquiries, and correspondence professionally in both English and Spanish.



PROACTIVE AND DETAIL-ORIENTED: Must demonstrate excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, accountability, and initiative.



FIXED WORK SCHEDULE: Must be willing and available to work Monday through Friday, following a fixed US Eastern Time (EST/EDT) schedule.



TIME TRACKING: Must be comfortable using company-required time-tracking software throughout working hours.



HIPAA COMPLIANCE: Must understand HIPAA regulations and demonstrate the ability to handle confidential patient information securely.



TECH-SAVVY: Must be proficient with computers, online communication tools, dental software, and remote working systems.



INDEPENDENT WORK: Must be able to work efficiently with minimal supervision while consistently meeting performance expectations.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



The selected candidate will be responsible for:



Patient Communication: Manage inbound calls, respond to patient inquiries, and maintain professional communication in English and Spanish.



Appointment Management: Schedule, confirm, cancel, and reschedule dental appointments while ensuring appropriate procedure durations and provider availability.



Schedule Optimization: Maintain an organized daily appointment schedule, manage scheduling conflicts, and apply appropriate double-booking procedures when authorized.



Patient Follow-Ups: Proactively contact patients regarding upcoming appointments, missed visits, treatment follow-ups, and pending scheduling requirements.



Dental Insurance Verification: Verify patient insurance eligibility, coverage, benefits, and relevant financial information.



Dentrix Documentation: Accurately document all patient interactions, appointment updates, and administrative activities within Dentrix.



Communication Tracking: Ensure that patient communications and follow-up activities are properly recorded, traceable, and accessible to authorized team members.



Dental Front-Office Support: Assist with general administrative tasks and daily dental practice operations.



Laboratory Case Management: Coordinate and track dental laboratory cases, monitor expected delivery dates, and follow up on outstanding cases.



Inventory Management: Assist with tracking dental supplies, monitoring inventory records, and coordinating inventory-related administrative requirements.



WORK ARRANGEMENT



Work Setup: 100% Remote / Work From Home



Employment Type: Full-Time



Workdays: Monday to Friday



Work Schedule: Fixed US Eastern Time Zone (EST/EDT)



Industry: US Dental Practice



Required Software: Dentrix



Required Languages: English and Spanish



FINAL REMINDER TO ALL APPLICANTS



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



You are not fluent in BOTH English and Spanish.



You speak Chavacano but are not fluent in Spanish.



You do not have actual hands-on experience using Dentrix.



You have never worked for a dental practice.



You do not have experience managing dental patient appointments and follow-ups.



You are unwilling to work US Eastern Time hours.



You are unwilling to use time-tracking software.



ALL THE ABOVE QUALIFICATIONS ARE NON-NEGOTIABLE.



We appreciate everyone's interest in joining Platonics. However, to respect both the applicants' time and our client's requirements, only candidates who meet ALL mandatory qualifications will be considered for screening and interviews.



Thank you for your understanding, and we look forward to receiving applications from qualified dental professionals!

title: SOFTWARE QA ENGINEER / SOFTWARE TESTER

* Create and execute test cases covering normal workflows, edge cases, and error conditions.



* Document defects with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, and expected versus actual results.

* Investigate application issues and help identify their possible causes.

* Strong manual and exploratory testing skills.



* Ability to independently identify, investigate, and document software defects.



* Experience creating and executing test cases and regression tests.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.



* Excellent attention to detail.

* Good written English communication skills.



* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



NICE TO HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

* Experience identifying usability issues and recommending improvements.



* Experience working with startups or small development teams.



* Familiarity with Lovable, Supabase, or similar development platforms is a plus.



POSITION DETAILS



Type: Short-term, project-based contract. Estimated 40–50 hours, depending on testing results and any issues discovered. Potential for additional projects in the future.



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide the following information:

3. A description of a significant software defect you personally discovered and how you investigated it.



4. Your experience performing manual, exploratory, and user acceptance testing.

title: Accountant in Practice (UK) - CPA Essential
description:
Summary

We’re not your average accountancy firm. We’re Complete HQ — Renegade Accountants for Extraordinary Businesses. We don’t do beige offices, jargon-laden letters, or “computer says no” advice. We do real numbers, real conversations, and real impact for the SMEs we work with.



Now we need someone who can own the engine room.



The Role



This is a focused, specialist role. Your world is limited company year-end accounts and CT600s. Not bookkeeping. Not VAT returns. Not personal tax. Not chasing missing receipts.



You’ll take a clean trial balance and turn it into FRS 102 1A or FRS 105 statutory accounts, file them at Companies House, prepare the corporation tax computation, and submit the CT600 to HMRC. Then you’ll do it again. And again. With the kind of consistency, accuracy, and turnaround that makes clients trust us and HMRC leave us alone.



If you love the technical craft of accounts prep and corporation tax — and you want to do it without being pulled in fifteen directions — this is your job.



What You’ll Actually Do



Prepare statutory year-end accounts for UK limited companies under FRS 102 1A and FRS 105

Prepare corporation tax computations and file CT600 returns with HMRC

Handle capital allowances, R&D considerations (flagging to our specialists), loss relief, group relief where relevant, and director/shareholder tax planning touchpoints

Identify and resolve issues in client records before they become problems — and feed them back to the bookkeeping team cleanly

File accounts at Companies House and confirm successful submission

Communicate directly with clients on queries, signatures, and deadlines — clearly, commercially, and without accountant-speak

Keep WIP moving, deadlines tracked, and Debbie (our Operations Director) sane

Spot planning opportunities and flag them to the advisory team — you don’t need to deliver them, but you need to see them



What We’re Looking For

Non-negotiables:



Accoun tancy qualified (fully qualified, not part-qualified)

Minimum 4 years in a UK accounting practice environment

Demonstrable track record preparing statutory accounts and CT600s autonomously, start to finish

Confident with FRS 102 1A and FRS 105

Fluent in Xero (we’re a Xero house), and ideally TaxCalc, IRIS, or similar accounts production software

Sharp on UK corporation tax — current rates, marginal relief, associated companies rules, the lot

Genuinely good with clients — written and verbal — without being either stiff or sloppy

Be within 3 hours for GMT/BST and able to between 8 - 18.00 UK time



Nice to have:



Experience with Karbon, Xero Tax, or similar workflow/practice management tools

Exposure to R&D tax credits, EMI schemes, or group structures

A view on AI and automation in practice that isn’t either evangelical or terrified

What You Are Not

A trainee looking for sign-off

A generalist who wants variety across bookkeeping, VAT, payroll, and personal tax

Allergic to deadlines, ownership, or direct feedback



What You Get

Fully remote. Work from wherever you do your best work. We’re based in Cornwall but the team is distributed.

A focused remit. No scope creep. No “can you just look at this VAT return.”

Modern tooling. Xero-first stack, proper workflow systems, no fax machines.

A grown-up culture. No timesheets-as-surveillance, no performative busy-ness, no political nonsense.

Direct access to leadership. You’ll work closely with me (Andrew, MD), Debbie (Ops Director), and our small team, making a real difference to our clients.

Competitive salary, DOE. We pay well for people who deliver.

Pension, holiday, and the usual. Plus the unusual: time and space to actually think.



How to Apply

Send your CV and a short note — not a covering letter, a note — telling us:



The most interesting technical accounts or CT issue you’ve handled in the last 12 months, and how you resolved it

Why a focused, single-discipline remote role appeals to you right now

Anything else we should know

Documenting interior fitouts in Revit. Plans, reflected ceiling plans, elevations, sections and details. Joinery and interior detailing. Finishes and FF&E schedules. Building families for joinery. Setting up sheets and issuing drawing sets for tender and construction.

AutoCAD and SketchUp useful but not essential.

Full time, independent contractor, paid monthly at $1,500 USD.

Send two PDFs. A sample of your documentation, two or three sheets showing plans, elevations and a joinery detail. And your CV.



Put the word JOINERY at the top so we know you read this.



No drawing sample, no reply.

title: Social Media influencer Outrach
description:
StackKicks is a Dutch brand that makes boxes for sneaker collectors. A big part of how we grow is working with sneaker creators on Instagram and TikTok. We are looking for a full time Creative Outreach Specialist to find those creators in the Netherlands and Germany and start working with them.



Every day you will look for sneaker creators who fit our brand. You start with the accounts we already follow and work with. You look through their followers, comments and similar accounts, and then you search sneaker hashtags on Instagram and TikTok. When you find a good fit, you follow them, leave a genuine comment on one of their recent posts, and send a friendly personal message asking if they would like to collaborate with us. If they don’t reply, you send one short follow up. If they say yes, you send them our offer, help them choose a package and set up their order. When their content goes live, you save the link.



You keep every creator’s status up to date in our dashboard. At the end of each working day you send a short report with how many creators you found, how many messages you sent, the replies you got and the deals you closed.



The way we talk to creators matters a lot to us. We keep it casual, happy and personal, like texting a friend. Everything is done by hand, so no bots and no automation tools. From day one you will get a clear guide, message scripts and our offer, so you always know what to do.



What we are looking for



You use Instagram and TikTok every day and you understand how creators work. You write casual, natural English and you know how to make a message feel personal instead of copy and paste. You are organised and careful with tracking. You can work on your own, stick to a daily routine and follow a process. You enjoy talking to people and you are not afraid to follow up. Experience with influencer outreach is a big plus. 



How to apply



Tell us a little about yourself and any outreach or social media work you have done before. Late us know how good your english is and we can have a meeting and start immediately!

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Calling Specialist
description:
Company: SO Good

Position: Remote | Full-Time

Base Pay: $500/month

Commission: 3% Monthly Recurring Commission



About the Role:

SO Good is looking for an experienced and results-driven Cold Calling Specialist who can build, manage, and execute our outbound lead generation process.

We're not simply looking for someone who can make phone calls. We need someone who understands how to identify qualified prospects, develop an organized cold calling system, engage business owners, and consistently book qualified sales appointments.

The ideal candidate must have a proven process for prospecting and cold calling, be confident speaking with business owners, and be capable of managing the outbound pipeline independently.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation: Research, identify, and build targeted lists of potential clients who fit SO Good's ideal customer profile.

Outbound Strategy: Develop a clear, step-by-step cold calling process, from finding leads to booking appointments.

Cold Calling: Contact prospective clients, introduce SO Good, identify potential needs, and generate interest in our services.

Lead Qualification: Determine whether prospects are a good fit before scheduling a sales call.

Appointment Setting: Book qualified meetings directly for our Sales Closer.

CRM Management: Maintain accurate records of calls, conversations, follow-ups, and appointment statuses.

Follow-Up Management: Establish a consistent follow-up process for prospects who are interested but not ready to schedule.

Process Improvement: Monitor performance, identify bottlenecks, and continuously improve the outbound system.



What We're Looking For:

Proven experience in B2B cold calling and appointment setting.

Strong communication skills and confidence speaking with business owners.

Experience building and managing outbound prospecting systems.

Ability to explain a detailed, repeatable cold calling process.

Experience with lead generation, qualification, objection handling, and follow-ups.

Highly organized, proactive, and capable of working independently.

Comfortable tracking performance through measurable KPIs.

We are looking for someone who already has an effective process, not someone who needs to be taught how to cold call from scratch.



Compensation:

$500 USD monthly base pay

3% monthly recurring commission on revenue collected from eligible clients sourced by the Appointment Setter.

Commission continues for as long as the referred client remains active and continues paying SO Good.

If the client cancels their partnership with SO Good, recurring commission stops in accordance with the commission agreement.



Training:

SO Good will provide training on our services, internal processes, and specific platforms, including Apollo and Watch Tower.

However, candidates are expected to bring their own cold calling expertise, proven techniques, and outbound process.

title: Microsoft 365 Administrator / Systems & Automation Consultant
description:
Position Type: Part-time employee or gig work

Hours: Approximately 5–15 hours per week initially, with hours varying based on projects



Our accounting firm is seeking an experienced Microsoft 365 professional to help us design, implement, and maintain a secure and efficient Microsoft-based technology environment. This is a hands-on, project-focused role. We are looking for someone who can evaluate our existing systems, recommend practical solutions appropriate for a small professional services firm, and then help us implement those solutions.



Our goal is not simply to move files into Microsoft 365. We want to build a well-organized, secure technology environment that supports our accounting practice, integrates with our existing systems, reduces manual processes, and can be effectively maintained by our staff going forward.



Key responsibilities include: 



Microsoft 365 & SharePoint Architecture

Lead the migration of firm data from ShareFile to Microsoft 365 document storage.

Review our existing file organization, workflows, security requirements, and user needs before developing the new structure.

Design and build a SharePoint architecture appropriate for an accounting and tax firm.

Recommend when information should reside in SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, or other Microsoft tools.

Establish document libraries, folder structures, permissions, retention considerations, and sharing practices.



Security & Access Management

Review and recommend best practices for Microsoft 365 user administration and access control.

Establish appropriate employee permissions based on roles and responsibilities.

Develop a secure process for granting, modifying, and removing employee access.

Recommend and configure appropriate methods for providing clients and other external users access to documents.

Help establish policies surrounding external sharing, guest users, confidential information, and client data.



Systems Integration

Assist with integration between Microsoft 365 and Karbon, our practice management system.

Evaluate opportunities to connect Microsoft tools with other systems used by the firm.

Recommend practical integration approaches that minimize unnecessary manual work.



Workflow Automation

Identify repetitive administrative processes that could reasonably be automated.

Build and maintain workflows using Power Automate and other appropriate Microsoft tools.

Help us determine when Power Automate, SharePoint, Teams, Forms, Lists, or another Microsoft solution is appropriate rather than developing overly complex custom solutions.

Document automations so they can be understood, maintained, and modified in the future.



Training, Documentation & Governance

Train existing staff on SharePoint, Microsoft document storage, sharing, and other newly implemented systems.

Develop clear written procedures and internal documentation.

Assist with policies and procedures covering user access and permissions, employee onboarding and offboarding, client/external user access, document storage and organization, external file sharing, data security, ownership and maintenance of Power Automate workflows

Help establish sustainable administrative practices so the firm's Microsoft environment does not become dependent on a single outside consultant.



Qualifications: We are particularly interested in candidates with hands-on experience in Microsoft 365 administration, SharePoint Online architecture and administration, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Teams and OneDrive, SharePoint permissions and external sharing, Power Automate, Microsoft 365 security and access management, file migrations into SharePoint/Microsoft 365, designing Microsoft environments for small or mid-sized businesses, and developing documentation and training non-technical users. Experience working with accounting firms, law firms, financial services firms, or other organizations handling confidential client information is strongly preferred.



Experience with Karbon or integrating Microsoft 365 with third-party SaaS applications is a significant plus.



The workload will initially be project-heavy as we redesign and migrate our systems. After implementation, we anticipate an ongoing need for periodic Microsoft 365 administration, troubleshooting, workflow improvement, and new automation projects. When applying, please include your favorite ice cream flavor in the subject line of your message.

title: PART-TIME E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS & LISTINGS ADMIN
description:
E-commerce Operations & Listings | Part-time, about 15 hours a week (up to 30 in launch and holiday weeks) | Remote (some overlap with US business hours) | Reports to Operations Lead



ABOUT LUX & NYX

Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell on our own Shopify site, Amazon, Nordstrom, Best Buy, Macy's, Belk, and Kohl's, and to corporate gifting buyers through ESP, SAGE, and rewards platforms like Stark. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu. We move fast. We build systems that compound. We hire people who can think and ship.



THE ROLE

You'll own the back end of our e-commerce business: the accuracy of every product we sell, everywhere we sell it, and everything that happens to an order after the customer clicks Buy.



One bag in one color lives on nine channels, each with its own template, rules, and error reports. You keep one master product sheet as the source of truth, push every launch, price change, and update out to every channel from it, and check each week that what's live matches what's true.



You also run backend operations for our online orders, and customer care for our own site: cancellations, refunds, chargebacks, fraud checks, warranty claims, warehouse issues, returns, and disputes. Every week you turn returns and reviews into a short update the team can act on.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Catalog and listings

1. Master product sheet: build and keep one source of truth for every SKU: UPC, dimensions, weight, materials, colors, image links, and units per master carton. Every channel template is filled from it. If a number isn't on file, you go get it from the right person. You never estimate it.

2. Launches and new colors: set up each new product on every channel from the master sheet, in each channel's template, and follow it through until it is live and correct.

3. Weekly listing health check: sweep every channel for suppressed or stranded Amazon listings, rejected marketplace uploads, retailer portal errors, broken variations, and feed errors. Fix what you can, escalate what you can't, and log both.

4. Price and promo updates: apply price and promo changes across every channel at once, and confirm no channel undercuts another or shows a price we didn't approve.

5. Corporate gifting and rewards catalogs (ESP, SAGE, Stark): keep quantity price breaks, imprint areas, decoration options, setup charges, and production times current and matched to the prices our sales team quotes. For Stark and our other rewards catalogs, maintain the Excel management file each partner receives: available-to-sell (ATS) quantity and image links for every SKU, checked against live stock and sent every month.

6. Images and UPCs: size and name images to each channel's specs, assign UPCs, and keep the UPC log.

7. Discontinued items: retire discontinued SKUs and colors on every channel, not just some.

8. Open tickets, followed until they clear: open cases with Amazon Seller Support, retailer portals, and marketplace support, and keep every open ticket in one log with its date opened, status, and next step. Follow up on each one every week until it is resolved and confirmed fixed on the live channel. Escalate anything open more than 2 weeks.



Backend operations and customer care

9. Customer care (D2C): answer our 
 for 
 customers within one business day, in our voice: order questions, warranty claims (including our Merci extended warranty), wrong, damaged or missing items, and product questions. Escalate goodwill calls with a recommendation.

10. Orders: enter orders, and handle cancellations, refunds, chargebacks, and fraud review in Shopify and our marketplace portals, by our policies and inside every deadline.

11. Fulfillment issues: be the day-to-day contact for our warehouse on missing, wrong, damaged, and stuck orders. Get each one fixed for the customer, spot patterns before they repeat, and file carrier claims when needed.

12. ShipStation: manage labels, voids, and shipping exceptions.

13. Loyalty and discounts: set up and check discount codes and loyalty rewards, and answer when one doesn't work.

14. Commercial invoices: prepare commercial invoices for shipments that cross a border.

15. Returns review: keep our returns tracker (returns app) current across every channel, and the Nordstrom returns file until it is replaced. Make sure every SKU is mapped, and dispute any refund or return that shouldn't have been charged to us.

16. Amazon: send review requests, and keep ranking and ads data in our Amazon file current (unless we stay with Adspert for ads).

17. Rankings: check product rankings on each channel each week, by hand when our tools can't.

18. Weekly reviews & returns update: update the weekly reviews file, including specifics on every warehouse issue, and bring a short update to the team huddle: our return rate against target, what changed and why, and the reviews the team needs to see.



Back-end admin

19. Files and folders: keep our Drive and backend files organized and named to our conventions.

20. Weekly channel report: pull a simple sales-by-channel report every week.

21. Retailer documents: upload compliance documents, certificates, and product specs to retailer vendor portals when requested.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

1. You catch what others miss. A wrong UPC, a price off by a dollar, a color named two different ways, a refund that's about to be paid twice. You find it before it goes live, every time. That's the #1 thing.

2. 2+ years managing product listings and e-commerce operations for a brand or seller, with hands-on Amazon flat-file uploads and fixing suppressed or stranded listings.

3. Hands-on backend and customer-care experience: customer
s, warranty claims, refunds, chargebacks, fraud review, returns, and working with a warehouse or 3PL.

4. Strong spreadsheet skills: VLOOKUP or INDEX-MATCH, filters, data validation, and cleaning messy product and order data into a template.

5. Good judgment with numbers: you can look at a return rate or a set of reviews and say what changed and why, in a few lines.

6. A builder. When a process was never written down, you write it down, get it checked, and make it the standard.

7. Clear written English. You'll write support cases, disputes, how-to guides, and updates to the team.

8. Steady in async, remote, founder-led work, with a few hours of overlap with US business hours each week.

9. Here for the long haul: someone who wants to own this work and get great at it.



A strong plus:

1. Mirakl marketplace experience (uploads, fixing rejected products, returns, and disputes).

2. ShipStation.

3. ESP or SAGE supplier catalog experience: quantity price breaks, imprint and decoration data.

4. Nordstrom or other retailer vendor portals.

5. Commercial invoices and international shipping paperwork.

6. Amazon Ads data or tools like Adspert.

7. Google Merchant Center or Meta catalog feeds.



WHAT SEPARATES GREAT FROM GOOD

1. Checks the live listing after the upload, not just that the upload went through.

2. Fixes the master sheet first, then the channel, so the same error never comes back.

3. Notices a channel that quietly stopped syncing before a customer does.

4. Sees two warehouse mistakes and asks if they're the same mistake.

5. Writes the how-to the first time they do a task, not the fifth.



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS

Targets calibrate quarterly. These are the outcomes you'll be measured on:

- Listing accuracy: zero live errors (price, spec, image, UPC) on any channel

- Health check: every channel checked every week; every issue logged with an owner

- Rewards catalog files: every ATS and image-link file sent monthly, on time, matching live stock

- Open tickets: every ticket followed up weekly; none open past 2 weeks without escalation

- Launch speed: new products and colors live on every channel within 5 business days of approval

- Price changes: live on every channel within 2 business days, with no mismatch between channels

- Customer care: every D2C
 answered within one business day, in our voice

- Orders: cancellations, refunds, and chargebacks handled inside every deadline; no order refunded twice

- Warehouse issues: every issue resolved for the customer, logged, and in the weekly update

- Returns: return rate tracked weekly against our target; every Nordstrom dispute filed while it can still be won

- Weekly reviews & returns update: ready for every team huddle

- Master sheet: every active SKU complete, including units per master carton

- SOP coverage: every recurring task documented



SCHEDULE AND PAY

Part-time and flexible. About 15 hours a week of steady work (customer care, orders, returns, health checks, sync checks, and the weekly update), rising to as many as 30 hours in launch and holiday weeks. Paid hourly with a monthly cap agreed in advance. You set your own hours, with a few hours of overlap with US business hours each week for questions and same-day order issues.



Competitive pay tied to experience. Remote-first culture with intentional async work.



HOW WE WORK TOGETHER

1. Weekly check-in with Michelle (operations), your manager: what launched, what's broken, what's stuck, what's next.

2. Day-to-day coordination with our warehouse on orders, returns, and stock, and with our Operations Coordinator, who owns our B2B accounts.

3. Weekly team huddle: you bring the reviews & returns update.

4. Async-first via Slack: decisions documented, same-day response on blockers.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word STITCH. Then, in three sentences, tell us about a listing upload that was rejected or went live wrong, or an order problem you caught: what the error was, how you found it, and what you changed so it didn't happen again. Then attach your resume. Applications that skip either step won't be read.



That one line is deliberate. This role is about catching the small detail everyone else skims past, and this is where we see it first.



ABOUT THE TEAM

We're a remote-first team. We run on weekly syncs, regular 1:1s, and quarterly goal-setting. We lead before we're asked. We think from the customer's perspective. We grow with intention. We think deeply before we act. If that's how you work too, we'd love to meet you.

title: VIDEO EDITOR WITH AI TOOLS EXPERIENCE (Performance Marketing Video Editor)
description:
VIDEO EDITOR WITH AI TOOLS EXPERIENCE — Full-Time, Long-Term

Only applications done through the form will be reviewed



We are looking for video editors… but honestly, the personality and attitude matter more than the portfolio.

At Lead Rush, we have built a training system and internal mentorship program that can take a talented editor and make them exceptional. What we cannot train is character. We cannot teach someone to communicate proactively, take ownership without being told, or show up with the kind of energy that makes a team better just by being in it.



So, if you are a great editor but a difficult person to work with — this is not the right fit.

If you are someone who is hungry to grow, communicates like a professional, and genuinely wants to be part of something you are proud of — we want to talk to you, even if your technical reel is not perfect yet.



WORK SCHEDULE

Monday to Friday

8:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST (1 hour lunch)



COMPENSATION

Base pay of 1500 to 2500 USD per month

With an extensive performance bonus structure that goes from 250 USD to 3000 USD per month, can be even more



ABOUT US

Lead Rush is a performance marketing agency spending $3–4.5M per month in paid ads, helping personal injury firms across the United States grow through social media advertising. We are hiring 2 full-time AI video editors to join a fast-moving creative team with competitive base pay, monthly performance bonuses, and real growth potential.



This is not freelance. This is not a short-term contract. We are building a team of people who want to be here for years — not editors balancing multiple clients on the side.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

Editing short-form direct response ads for Meta and YouTube, with occasional long-form YouTube content. This is performance advertising — not cinematic brand work or filmmaking. You will use AI tools like Higgsfield, Kling, Google Flow, and similar platforms to build high-converting creatives from scripts and concepts, and collaborate closely with our creative team on testing and iteration.



WHAT WE ARE ACTUALLY LOOKING FOR

Technical skills matter, but they are not the whole picture. The editors who thrive here have two things in common: they communicate well and they take ownership.

We work fast, we give direct feedback, and we expect people to show up consistently and professionally. You do not need to be perfect — but you do need to respond promptly, raise problems early, accept feedback without ego, and follow through on what you commit to.

We are also specifically looking for people who fit naturally into a US-based work culture. That means proactive communication, a collaborative mindset, and the kind of reliability and professionalism that makes a remote team actually function. If you need to be chased down or managed closely, this is not the right fit.



WHAT ARE EDITORS SAY ABOUT US

- Exceptional base pay

- Monthly performance bonuses tied to winning ads

- Skills growth opportunities (we get a lot of coaching/upskilling opportunities internally)

- Clear career advancement path

- Creative, fast-paced work with real ownership

- A team that genuinely supports each other and pushes each other to improve

Here is what Anika, one of our editors, has to say: 



REQUIREMENTS

- Experience with AI video generation tools — if you have not used them, do not apply

- Strong grasp of hooks, pacing, retention, and conversion-focused editing

- Proficiency in CapCut, Canva, ElevenLabs, and modern AI workflows

- Ability to source compelling B-roll, music, and visuals

- Excellent communication and a professional, team-first attitude

- A growth mindset — someone who takes feedback as fuel, improves consistently, and wants to get better every single week. 



To apply:

title: Executive Assistant to the Founder
description:

I run

COMMUNICATION AND SELECTION



WhatsApp for text and voice during agreed working hours. We communicate directly and use first names. Please call me David. Reliable internet and a backup connection required.

Pay and time off: paid on the 15th and 30th of each month, 10 paid days off per year plus Philippine holidays or alternate days by agreement, a $25/month internet and power stipend, and a compensation review at 6 months.





TO APPLY



Use the subject line "Founder EA" and include:



- Your resume or LinkedIn profile, expected monthly compensation, availability, and current client commitments. This is a dedicated role: existing commitments must end before you start; no other clients while in this role.

- Who you supported longest and three responsibilities you took off their plate.

- One real AI-assisted task, the prompt or a description of the agent you used, and how you checked the result.

- Something you recently taught yourself without being asked: what sparked your interest, what you tried, and what happened.

- A 1-2 minute voice introduction. Final interviews will be live on video.

description:

 outreach tools, and lead generation techniques.

title: B2B Sales & Logistics Assistant [NetSuite exp. required]

This is a role for someone who has personally processed sales orders in NetSuite, can spot discrepancies in commercial terms, and is confident taking sensible decisions or escalating issues when needed.



What you will do

s during UK business hours.

• Check purchase orders against agreed prices, commercial terms, minimum order quantities and available stock; resolve discrepancies with customers or colleagues.

• Enter orders in NetSuite, check stock is allocated, and follow orders through to delivery arrangements.

• Manage back-orders and, where stock is limited, assess partial fulfilment within agreed authority and keep customers updated.

• Help maintain product information in our PIM and retailer price lists.



What you need

• Hands-on experience entering and managing sales orders in NetSuite. Please explain exactly what you have done in the system.

• Experience managing business-to-business sales orders, stock availability and customer communication.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to write clear, accurate and professional
s.

• Strong attention to detail with prices, quantities and commercial terms; sound judgement and reliable follow-through.

• Availability to monitor and respond to
 between 09:00 and 17:00 UK time on working days. Other work can be completed flexibly.



Working arrangements



Remote. Contract type, weekly hours, rate and start date: to be confirmed. 

Please state your availability and proposed rate when applying. 

UK time changes between GMT and BST; your availability must cover 09:00–17:00 throughout the year.



How to apply

Please send your CV and answer the following in the order shown. Brief, specific answers are more useful than a generic cover letter. Do not include confidential customer or employer information.



 1. Describe your hands-on NetSuite experience: the sales order tasks you performed, how recently you used it, and for how long.

 2. Give an example of an order discrepancy or stock shortage you resolved. What did you check, what did you d
, and what was the result?

 3. Confirm your time zone, availability to monitor
 from 09:00–17:00 UK time, and the response time you can normally maintain.

 4. State your proposed rate, weekly capacity and earliest start date.

 5. Write a short customer
: their PO requests 100 units, but only 60 are available. A partial delivery may be possible, subject to approval. Acknowledge the order, explain the position and request the information you need without promising delivery.



Applications that do not answer all five questions will not be considered. We may follow up with a practical assessment and references.
