title: Now Hiring: Senior YouTube SEO & Video Content Specialist
description:
**Experience Required:** 5–8 Years Minimum  

**Work Schedule:** Must work during Bulgaria business hours (Eastern European Time)  

**Specialization:** YouTube SEO, Video Production, Canva, ElevenLabs AI, Analytics & Channel Growth



## Position Overview



We are seeking a highly experienced, creative, and results-driven **YouTube SEO & Video Content Specialist with a minimum of 5+ years of hands-on experience** managing, producing, editing, and optimizing YouTube content.



The ideal candidate combines advanced YouTube SEO knowledge with strong video editing, content development, analytics, and channel optimization skills.



This is not simply a video editing position. We need a specialist who understands how YouTube works, how audiences search for content, what drives engagement, and how to improve video visibility, watch time, audience retention, and website traffic.



You must be proactive, detail-oriented, technically proficient, and capable of identifying opportunities to improve both new and existing videos.



Our content focuses primarily on healthcare, mental health, addiction treatment, recovery, and educational topics.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. YouTube SEO & Keyword Research



- Conduct comprehensive YouTube keyword research and competitor analysis.

- Identify high-value keywords, search trends, audience questions, and search intent.

- Optimize video titles, descriptions, chapters, and relevant metadata.

- Develop strategies to improve organic search visibility and video discoverability.

- Identify opportunities to improve rankings for existing videos.

- Recommend new video topics based on search demand, audience interests, and competitive opportunities.



### 2. Video Production & Canva Editing



- Create professional, engaging videos using Canva.

- Edit existing footage and develop new educational video content.

- Incorporate professional transitions, captions, animations, graphics, and consistent branding.

- Develop compelling introductions and hooks to improve audience retention.

- Maintain high standards for video quality, pacing, audio, and visual presentation.

- Design attention-grabbing, professional YouTube thumbnails.

- Ensure videos are optimized for desktop and mobile viewing.

- Produce YouTube Shorts and long-form videos as assigned.



### 3. AI Voiceovers – ElevenLabs



- Create professional, natural-sounding AI voiceovers using ElevenLabs.

- Ensure accurate pronunciation, appropriate tone, pacing, and clear audio.

- Synchronize voiceovers with video footage, captions, and visual elements.

- Identify and correct voiceover errors before publication.

- Maintain consistent voice quality and branding across content.



### 4. YouTube Channel Optimization & Growth



- Optimize existing videos to improve discoverability, click-through rates, and engagement.

- Organize playlists, video categories, and channel content.

- Implement appropriate end screens, cards, and calls to action.

- Recommend strategies to increase subscribers, watch time, and returning viewers.

- Evaluate thumbnail and title performance and recommend improvements.

- Identify opportunities to drive qualified website traffic from YouTube.



### 5. YouTube Analytics & Performance Tracking



You must have advanced working knowledge of YouTube Studio and understand how to interpret performance data.



Responsibilities include monitoring and analyzing:



- Video impressions and click-through rates (CTR).

- Average view duration and total watch time.

- Audience retention and viewer drop-off points.

- Organic YouTube search traffic.

- Suggested video and browse traffic.

- Subscriber growth and engagement.

- Individual video performance and channel growth trends.

- Website traffic generated through YouTube, using GA4 and properly tagged links where appropriate.



You will be expected to turn analytics into specific, actionable recommendations rather than simply reporting numbers.



### 6. Review, Audit & Improve Existing Videos



A critical part of this position involves reviewing our existing YouTube content and proactively identifying areas for improvement.



You must be able to:



- Identify editing mistakes, spelling errors, and grammatical issues.

- Detect poor audio quality, voiceover errors, and synchronization problems.

- Recognize weak introductions and opportunities to improve viewer retention.

- Identify outdated information and inconsistent branding.

- Evaluate existing titles, descriptions, thumbnails, and SEO opportunities.

- Correct editable elements and update source files when necessary.

- Recommend when videos should be revised, replaced, or republished.



When a correction requires replacing an existing YouTube upload, you must communicate the issue to management and coordinate the appropriate next steps.



All factual, medical, and clinical content changes must receive approval from the appropriate company reviewer before publication.



**We expect someone who identifies problems, recommends solutions, and takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what needs improvement.**



### 7. Reporting & Continuous Improvement



- Provide regular YouTube performance reports.

- Identify top-performing and underperforming videos.

- Explain why specific content is performing well or poorly.

- Recommend actionable improvements based on performance data.

- Track optimization efforts and their impact over time.

- Suggest new content opportunities and growth strategies.

- Help develop and improve internal YouTube production procedures and standard operating procedures (SOPs).



## Reporting Structure & Team Collaboration



You will report directly to an internal company team member responsible for managing daily workflows, project priorities, deadlines, quality control, and approvals.



While your manager may not have the same level of specialized YouTube experience, you are expected to respect the established reporting structure and follow management direction.



We are hiring you for your technical knowledge and expertise. We expect you to bring that expertise to the team while working collaboratively within our management structure.



You must be comfortable:



- Following assigned priorities, deadlines, and established workflows.

- Explaining technical recommendations in a clear, professional manner.

- Accepting feedback and completing requested revisions.

- Communicating proactively with your manager.

- Sharing your expertise and helping improve internal processes.

- Taking responsibility for the quality and accuracy of your work.



**Your manager is responsible for workflow and approvals. You are responsible for providing the specialized YouTube expertise, execution, and recommendations necessary to support our goals.**



## Required Qualifications



**Applicants must have a minimum of 5–8 years of professional experience in YouTube content management, SEO, video production, or closely related work.**



Additional requirements:



- Proven experience optimizing and growing YouTube channels.

- Advanced understanding of YouTube SEO and search intent.

- Strong proficiency in Canva video editing and thumbnail design.

- Hands-on experience with ElevenLabs AI voiceovers.

- Excellent understanding of YouTube Studio analytics.

- Ability to create both short-form and long-form video content.

- Strong copywriting skills for titles, descriptions, and video scripts.

- Experience conducting competitor research and content audits.

- Ability to identify and correct video quality issues independently.

- Strong attention to detail and quality assurance.

- Excellent communication, organization, and time management.

- Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.

- Willingness to follow established company workflows and management direction.

- Ability to work during Bulgaria business hours.



**Preferred Qualifications**



- Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, addiction treatment, or educational content.

- Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 (GA4).

- Experience with AI-assisted video production tools.

- Understanding of website conversion tracking and lead generation.

- Experience developing YouTube content strategies and SOPs.



## Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be evaluated based on:



1. Quality and consistency of published video content.

2. Accuracy and effectiveness of YouTube SEO implementation.

3. Improvements in audience engagement, retention, and discoverability.

4. Ability to identify and correct existing content issues.

5. Timely completion of assigned projects and revisions.

6. Quality of analytics reporting and actionable recommendations.

7. Communication, initiative, and collaboration with management.

8. Contribution to long-term channel development and website traffic growth.



YouTube growth, rankings, and traffic are influenced by multiple factors. We expect consistent, data-driven optimization and professional execution, not guaranteed outcomes.



## Work Schedule & Time Zone Requirements



**All applicants must be available to work during Bulgaria business hours (Europe/Sofia time zone).**



This is a firm scheduling requirement. Candidates must be able to coordinate with our internal team, attend scheduled meetings, communicate during working hours, and complete assignments according to established deadlines.



Applicants located outside Bulgaria are welcome, provided they can consistently work the required schedule.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following information:



1. **Professional Experience:** A summary of your YouTube SEO, channel management, and video editing experience, including total years of experience.

2. **Portfolio:** Links to YouTube channels and videos you have personally managed, edited, or optimized. Clearly explain your specific contributions.

3. **Canva Examples:** Samples of videos and thumbnails created using Canva.

4. **ElevenLabs Experience:** Examples of AI voiceovers you have produced or managed.

5. **Measurable Results:** Examples of improvements in YouTube traffic, rankings, engagement, CTR, retention, or subscriber growth, including relevant timeframes.

6. **Availability:** Confirmation that you can work during Bulgaria business hours.

7. **Compensation:** Your expected hourly or monthly rate.



**Applications without relevant YouTube experience or examples of previous work may not be considered.**



## Our Ideal Candidate



We are looking for a **YouTube specialist who thinks strategically, executes professionally, and takes ownership of their work.**



You should understand the complete YouTube content lifecycle—from keyword research and creative development to video editing, publishing, analytics, and ongoing optimization.



We value initiative, accountability, technical expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively within a structured team.



**If you have 5+ years of experience, strong YouTube SEO expertise, advanced Canva skills, ElevenLabs experience, and the ability to improve channel performance through data-driven decisions, we encourage you to apply.**

title: Instagram Account Creator – iPhone 12+ Required
description:
## Job Description



I am looking for a reliable and detail-oriented person to create at least 30 Instagram accounts per day by following a simple, recorded step-by-step tutorial.



This is a straightforward task. You do not need previous experience because I will provide a complete video tutorial and all necessary instructions. Your job is simply to follow the instructions carefully and create the accounts.



You can choose your own working hours. The only requirement is that you submit at least 30 profiles per day. You can take one day off per week, but it's important to let us know in advance.



### Payment

- $0.40 per successfully created account

- Daily target: minimum 30 accounts ( no upper limit)

- Expected daily earnings: $12

- Payment is based on successfully completed accounts.



### Equipment Requirements – READ BEFORE APPLYING



**DO NOT APPLY UNLESS YOU MEET EVERY SINGLE REQUIREMENT BELOW.**



You MUST have:



1. **An iPhone 12 or newer** (iPhone 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, or newer).

2. **A computer or laptop**.

3. **A separate personal phone** for your everyday use.



You need TWO separate phones:

- One iPhone 12 or newer dedicated to this work.

- One personal phone for your regular daily use.



**IMPORTANT:** The work iPhone will need to be reset multiple times. You must be comfortable using it exclusively for this job and resetting it when instructed.



I will provide the necessary work-related setup and instructions, including proxies, iCloud setup, Shadowrocket, and other required tools. You do not need to purchase these yourself.



### Responsibilities

- Follow the recorded tutorial step by step.

- Create at least 30 Instagram accounts per day.

- Follow all instructions carefully and consistently.

- Keep track of completed accounts.

- Report any technical issues promptly.

- Maintain reliable communication and meet the daily target.



### Who Should Apply?

This position is ideal for someone who is reliable, organized, follows instructions well, and has the required equipment ready.



### Before Applying



Please apply ONLY if you already have:

- An iPhone 12 or newer that you can dedicate to this work.

- A separate personal phone.

- A computer or laptop.



**Applications from people who do not meet ALL three equipment requirements will not be considered. Please do not apply if you cannot meet these requirements.**



When applying, confirm that you meet every requirement and specify your iPhone model.

Meta Ads

Campaign Management & Reporting

Identify underperforming campaigns and recommend improvements.

What We're Looking For

Proven experience building campaigns from scratch, not just monitoring existing campaigns.



Strong knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.

Clear campaign strategies and support from our UK team.



Exposure to multiple advertising accounts and campaign types.



Opportunity to take ownership of campaign performance.

We require a short video application demonstrating your actual Google Ads and Meta Ads experience.



Applications without a video demonstration will not be considered.



Please record a 5–10 minute video using Loom or a similar screen-recording tool covering the following:



1. Introduce Yourself (1 minute)



Tell us about your experience, how long you have been running paid advertising campaigns and the types of businesses you have worked with.



2. Google Ads Campaign Demonstration (2–4 minutes)



Share your screen and walk us through a real Google Ads campaign you have personally built or managed.



Show us:



The campaign and ad group structure.



The keywords and match types you selected.



Your bidding strategy and budget.

title: Software Developer
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



You’ll write the software that sits behind the brand: the tools our teams use, the integrations that connect our systems, and the experiences our customers see. You’ll talk to the people who use what you ship, and build the thing that actually fixes their problem, not the thing they first described.



For a sharp, driven engineer who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: a central role in how a growing brand runs.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Build what the business needs. Work with marketing, creative, operations, and support to find where software can save time, cut errors, or unlock growth, then build it.



Improve the customer experience. Build and refine the features on our store and sites that help customers find, trust, and buy, and keep them fast, reliable, and easy to use on every device. 



Connect our systems. Build and maintain the integrations between our store, fulfillment partners, ad platforms,
, support tools, and analytics, so data flows where it should and nobody retypes anything.



Automate the repetitive work. Find the tasks that eat people’s hours and turn them into scripts, workflows, and tools that run on their own.



Make the numbers trustworthy. Build the data pipelines, tracking, and dashboards that let the team see what’s working, and keep them accurate.



Build with AI. Design and ship features and workflows powered by AI, from tools that speed up our team’s work to experiences that help our customers.



Ship fast, and ship well. Move from idea to production quickly, in small steps, with code that’s tested, readable, and easy for the next person to change.



Keep it secure and running. Handle customer and company data carefully, follow the privacy rules in every market we sell in, and fix what breaks before it affects anyone.



Choose the simple solution. Question every layer of complexity. Pick the right tool for each job, not the most impressive one.



Write it down. Document what you build and how it works, so nothing lives only in your head.



Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI coding tools to speed up design, implementation, testing, and documentation, then apply your own judgment to make sure the result is correct, secure, and maintainable.



What we look for



Strong fundamentals. You write clean, correct code, understand how the pieces of a system fit together, and can reason your way through a problem you haven’t seen before.



Pragmatism. You ship the simplest thing that works well, and you improve it with real feedback instead of building for imaginary needs.



Product sense. You care who uses what you build. You ask good questions, notice when the request isn’t the real problem, and test your work against reality.



Judgment under pressure. You stay steady when something breaks, find the real cause quickly, and keep people informed while you fix it.



Clear communication. You can explain technical things to non-technical people in plain words, and your written updates leave no one guessing.



Ownership. You treat every system you build as yours until it works for the people using it. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [3+] years building and shipping production software, with strong skills across the front end and back end. Experience integrating with third-party APIs and working with data is essential. Experience in e-commerce or consumer brands is a strong advantage. Excellent English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact you can see. What you build goes live fast and is used by real people right away. You’ll see the whole company work better because of it.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.



Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the engineer who builds our foundations is the person best placed to lead the team behind them.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you’ll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

title: E-Commerce Operations Coordinator
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



About the Role



Mary Brown Naturals is seeking a proactive, management-oriented, and detail-focused E-Commerce Virtual Assistant to support and grow our online retail presence.



The ideal candidate has hands-on e-commerce and management experience and understands how to turn product listings, online promotions, customer engagement, and other digital sales activities into measurable results.

You will manage daily e-commerce operations across Amazon Seller Central and Shopify, overseeing product listings, inventory updates, order fulfillment, pricing, and promotions. You will maintain accurate product data, monitor platform performance, prepare reports, and coordinate with suppliers and the e-commerce salesperson to ensure efficient workflows across both platforms.



Why Join Us?

-Flexible Work: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time while earning.

-Competitive Hourly Pay: Earn $3.20 per hour for 10 hours per week.

-Professional Growth: Build your skills in Amazon and Shopify management.

-Work-Life Balance: Enjoy part-time work that fits your schedule while gaining valuable experience.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. E-Commerce Platform Management

Manage and optimize product listings on Amazon Seller Central and Shopify e-commerce platform.

Coordinating with Amazon Seller Central and Shopify activities, including product listings, inventory, order fulfillment, and platform monitoring. 

Ensure product listings are accurate, complete, and optimized for visibility and conversions.

Monitor and report on performance and identify opportunities for improvement.



2. Product Listing & Compliance

Regularly review and update products as needed to maintain accuracy and compliance with Amazon and website requirements.

Ensure pricing, product descriptions, images, and other listing details are consistent and up to date.



3. Sales & Trend Analysis

Monitor e-commerce, social media, and consumer trends.

Research competitors, products, and promotional strategies.

Identify opportunities to improve product visibility and sales.

Provide recommendations based on sales performance and market observations.



4. Team Coordination: Work collaboratively with the E-Commerce Sales & Digital Marketing Representative on product listings, inventory availability, order fulfillment, and promotional implementation. The Coordinator does not supervise or evaluate the Sales Representative.



5. Decision-Making Authority: Obtain approval from the business owner or designated manager before implementing pricing changes, promotional activities, expenditures, or significant operational decisions beyond established authority.



6. Operational Performance Monitoring: Monitor and report operational performance, including listing accuracy, inventory status, order processing, fulfillment progress, and task completion. The Coordinator is responsible for operational efficiency and accuracy, not for achieving the Sales Representative's sales or revenue targets.



7. Issue Resolution & Escalation: Resolve routine operational issues within established procedures and delegated authority. Promptly escalate significant issues, customer disputes, inventory risks, and matters requiring management approval or decisions to the business owner or designated manager.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



-We are looking for someone who is organized, proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented. The ideal candidate can:

-Manage daily e-commerce operations independently.

-Take initiative and improve workflows.

-Maintain accurate product listings and inventory records.

-Monitor orders and platform performance.

-Identify and resolve operational issues.

-Communicate progress and challenges clearly.

-Manage time effectively and meet deadlines.

title: Head Coach (Ecommerce)
description:
About PHNYX Group

PHNYX Group is a venture studio with operations in Dubai, Switzerland and China. We partner with founders to build, scale and exit ecommerce brands.

Our founder has built multiple brands, including PHNYX Watches, which has done millions in revenue. Exit Worthy Founder is our main program for founders doing $25K+ a month who have a team.



Why this role exists

Our founder diagnoses each client's brand and d
 what needs to be set up. We need experienced operators to take that plan and make sure the client's team actually executes it.

You are not here to come up with a new method. You are here to run a proven one, with discipline, for a small group of serious founders.



What you will own

A group of 5 to 10 EWF clients, each with a plan from our founder

2 one-hour calls a month with each client's team (4 a month for clients who pay for the upgrade)

Turning every call into a clear action list, logged the same day

Giving most feedback by Loom video or 
, with replies within 24 hours

Tracking each client's numbers from day 1 to day 120

Flagging problems early to our founder and Client Success

Helping clients finish strong so they renew or move into The Boardroom





What success looks like

After 90 days:

Every client's team is executing at least 80% of their weekly actions

Every client can point to real progress in their brand

No refunds caused by delivery

You are trusted with 10 clients



Who we are looking for

Someone who has done it, not just studied it. You have built or scaled an ecommerce brand and managed a team. Founders respect you because you know the work.

You are organized, calm and direct. You hold people to what they said they would do, without being harsh.



Compensation

$1,500/month for up to 5 clients, after a 15-day paid trial ($750)

$2,500–$3,000/month once we launch group coaching (10 to 20 clients)

$1,000 bonus for every client whose brand reaches $400,000 in a month

Paid via PayPal or card payment (not bank transfer). Paid at the end of each month for the first 4 months, then on the 15th and the last day of each month.



15-day paid trial

You start with a 15-day paid trial ($750) of real work. You shadow our founder's calls, then take your first clients. If it goes well, you move to a month-to-month contract.



How to apply

1. Subject line: "EWF Head Coach - [Your Name]" (we use this to check attention to detail)

2. The ecommerce brands you built or scaled, with your role and the numbers

3. Proof of results: revenue screenshots, case studies or client results

4. A Loom video, 3 minutes max, introducing yourself

5. Your answers to the application questions



Each question asks for specifics that are hard to fake. Vague answers score low.

1. Which ecommerce brand did you build or scale? What was it doing when you started, and when you left? What did YOU own?

2. What is the hardest problem you fixed in a brand doing $25K+ a month? What did you do, step by step?

3. Have you coached or advised other founders? How many, for how long, and what changed for them?

4. A client's team agreed to 6 actions last week and finished 2. What do you do on this week's call?

5. A founder disagrees with the plan our founder gave them. How do you handle it?

6. Which numbers do you check first when you look at a brand's Shopify and Meta ads? Why?

7. How do you take notes on a call and turn them into action items? Share a real example (remove private details).

8. Have you sourced products from China or managed suppliers? Tell us about one problem you solved.

9. How many client or team calls a week have you handled before?

10. Can you take 1-hour calls in US Eastern and Gulf time zones, 5 days a week? Yes or no.

title: $800/mo base + commission ($1,250 target): B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
Anvil Facility Services (
) is a commercial cleaning company in New York City, Long Island and New Jersey. We clean offices, medical and dental practices, high-end retail stores and similar facilities.



We are hiring one experienced B2B cold caller to book in-person walkthroughs with business owners and office managers. This is the first seat on a sales team we are building. If you do well here, you will lead that team.



WHO WE WANT

You have cold called US businesses, carried a quota and beaten it more than once, and you can tell us the numbers. You don't need a script to sound good. When a receptionist blocks you, you find another way to the decision maker. When an owner says "we already have someone," you keep the conversation going. When something isn't working, you tell us what to change.



If you want to be told exactly what to say and what to do every hour, this role is not for you.



THE WORK

- Call businesses across NYC, Long Island and New Jersey. We supply the core lists. You spend part of each day finding decision makers, cleaning up the lists and finding new prospects.

- Get past the front desk to whoever makes the cleaning decision.

- Qualify every prospect before you book. We give you the criteria.

- Book the walkthrough on the owner's calendar through our booking link before the call ends.

- Confirm every meeting:
 the same day, reminder the day before, text the morning of. A meeting that doesn't happen doesn't count.

- Log every call in our dialer.

- Send a short end-of-day report with your numbers.



HOW WE WORK TOGETHER

- You get talk tracks, objection notes and a clear customer profile. You don't get a word-for-word script. Use your own words.

- Each day you get 90 minutes, outside your dialing time, to research prospects, review your calls and work out how to book more meetings.

- Every week you have a 30-minute review with the owner. Bring your numbers, what is working, what isn't, and one proposed change to the list, the industry or the pitch. We change things based on what you see on the phones.

- No list is made up only of decision makers. If a list is bad, tell us early and bring a proposed fix. Don't wait until week three.



PAY

- $800 a month base, paid weekly on Monday for the prior week. The base stays the same after the trial period.

- $30 for every walkthrough that takes place. Cancellations and no-shows pay nothing.

- Quota/Example: 15 held walkthroughs in a month pays $1,250. 20 held pays $1,400. There is no cap.

- Base pay is prorated for US holidays when there is no work. We share the holiday calendar when you start.



EXPECTATIONS

- Month 1: ramp-up. Learn the offer, the customer and the lists. Target is 6 held walkthroughs.

- Month 2: 10 held walkthroughs.

- Month 3 onward: quota is 12 held walkthroughs a month. Strong callers do 20.



GROWTH

We plan to add callers. The strongest performer will hire, train and lead them, with pay to match.



HOURS

Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM New York time. That's 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila from November to March and 9:00 PM to 5:00 AM the rest of the year. The role is full time and the hours are fixed.



Daily schedule (New York time):

- 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM: dialing

- 12:00 PM to 1:30 PM: confirmations, prospect research, call review and planning

- 1:30 PM to 2:00 PM: break

- 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM: dialing



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years cold calling US businesses (B2B) with a quota. Name the company, what you sold and your results.

- A neutral American accent. US receptionists should never ask you to repeat yourself.

- Wired internet with 10 Mbps upload or better, plus a backup plan for power and internet outages.

- A USB headset with a boom mic and a quiet room.



HELPFUL

- Selling a service such as cleaning, facilities, staffing, IT or marketing.

- CloudTalk, HubSpot or another power dialer.

- Finding decision-maker contact details with tools like Apollo, ZoomInfo or LinkedIn.

- Experience training or leading other callers.



HOW TO APPLY

We don't read applications that skip a step. We also delete applications that were clearly written by AI. We want to hear from you, not from a chatbot.



STEP 1. Subject line: Anvil - [your name] - [your best month's quota attainment, e.g. 140%]



STEP 2. Keep your written message under 150 words. Use plain sentences, no bullet points. Include:

- Your last two cold calling roles: company name, what you sold, who you called (titles), your quota and your actual results.

- The dialer you used most and your typical connect rate.

- Why you stand out from the hundreds of other candidates applying for this role.

- A fun fact about yourself.



STEP 3. Attach one audio recording, 2 to 3 minutes long, recorded in one take with no editing or reading. Answer these out loud:

- How you would open a cold call to an office manager at a 20-person company.

- Your best month. How many meetings did you set, and what did you do differently?

- A time a campaign wasn't working. What did you tell your manager, and what changed?



NEXT STEPS

Shortlisted applicants do a 15-minute interview with the owner. The best performer starts right away. The first 30 days are a trial period, with full base pay and commission.

title: Permitting Coordinator
description:
Permitting Coordinator (Remote, Philippines-Based)

Coharbor Electric LLC | 20 hours a week--with potential to grow as we grow | US Eastern Business Hours

 

About Coharbor Electric



Coharbor Electric is a licensed residential and commercial electrical contractor serving southwest Florida. We handle everything from residential service and repairs to commercial electrical work, generator installations, commercial maintenance, and permanent smart lighting.

 

Our mission is simple: high-quality electrical work done with integrity. We’re built on integrity, accountability, veteran leadership, faith-based leadership, and teamwork.

 

You’ll be joining a growing team that already includes five Philippines-based teammates who work closely with our Florida office every day.

 

About the Role



The Permitting Coordinator owns the full permit lifecycle for Coharbor jobs across Lee County, Collier County, Sarasota County and the cities within them. You’re the link between our project managers, field techs, customers, and the building departments. You make sure every job is permitted correctly, inspected on time, and closed out on record. You will set up the disconnect and reconnect power coordinating with the Install Manager. 

 

A permit left open after the job is done is unfinished business. It becomes a compliance problem for us and a property-record problem for the customer. The right person for this role doesn’t let that happen.



Key Responsibilities



Permit Applications

Identify the correct permitting authority for each job address, including city versus unincorporated county.

Assemble complete permit packets, including scope of work, load calculations and drawings where required, contractor license details, certificates of insurance, and Notices of Commencement.

Submit applications through each jurisdiction’s online portal or intake process.

Follow up on stalled applications, respond to plan reviewer comments, and handle corrections and resubmittals.



Tracking, Inspections & Close-Out

Maintain a permit tracker showing every open permit’s status, dates, fees, and next action at a glance.

Schedule and confirm inspections, and coordinate with techs so the site is ready.

Track failed inspections through to a passed re-inspection, routing correction notices to the right person.

Make sure no permit expires while a job is open, and close out every permit with a passed final.

Resolve expired permits by reapplying, clearing fees, and scheduling follow-up inspections.



Liaison & Communication

Act as the main point of contact between building departments and our internal team on permit matters.

Call and
 building departments during Florida business hours.

Give project managers and customers clear, timely permit status updates.

Escalate blockers early and in writing, stating what’s needed and from whom.



Compliance & Records

Review scopes before submission and flag anything that won’t pass review as written.

Build and maintain a reference library of each jurisdiction’s requirements, fees, and inspection procedures.

Verify that licenses and insurance certificates are current before they go on an application.

Track permit fees and keep records organized so anyone on the team can find a job’s status without asking.



Required Qualifications

Hands-on permit coordination or regulatory compliance experience, meaning you personally prepared and submitted applications.

Ability to manage many open items and deadlines at once without losing the quiet ones.

Strong Excel skills: you build your own trackers with filters, sorting, and formulas.

Confident spoken and written English, and you’re comfortable making several outbound calls a day to US government offices.

Exceptional attention to detail. A wrong address or an expired certificate means a rejected application and a crew standing still.

Takes correction as information, not criticism.

Reliable high-speed internet, a headset, and a quiet workspace.

Available to work US Eastern business hours (night shift in the Philippines).



Preferred Qualifications

USA permitting experience

Electrical or construction trade background.

Experience with permit portals such as Accela, EnerGov, or similar.

2+ years of construction-related office work.



Tools You’ll Use

ServiceTitan, Microsoft 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word, Teams, SharePoint), and county and city permit portals.



What Makes You a Great Fit

You keep working the tail of the list until every permit is closed.

You don’t guess at a rule you don’t know. You find out who to ask, ask clearly, and write the answer down for the next person.

You flag problems while they’re small, without being asked.

You keep a system, not a memory.

You’re steady. You build a routine on a US schedule and hold it.



What We Offer

100% remote, full-time

A stable, growing team with five Philippines-based teammates already on board

title: CEO MUM Podcast — Video Editor
description:
CEO MUM is looking for an experienced freelance Podcast Video Editor for our upcoming 10-episode season, with the potential for ongoing work afterwards.



CEO MUM, hosted by Jada Sezer, is an interview-led video podcast about motherhood, ambition, careers and entrepreneurship, for ambitious women expecting or raising young children. Our message: Become a mother. Keep building.



You'll take each recording through the complete post-production process: the long-form video episode, professionally mastered audio, a trailer, and, if it's your strength, social clips, thumbnails and covers.



We want an all-rounder, but three skills come first:



1. Editing. You can shape a 60-minute, two-camera conversation into a tight, story-led episode of about 40 minutes, with clips that stop the scroll.



2. Sound. You can deliver a finished, professional podcast audio master: clean, warm, balanced and mastered to spec. This is essential, not a bonus.



3. Colour grade. You can make every frame look bright, clean and premium, with two cameras matched and skin that looks natural and luminous. This is essential too.



We know few editors are equally strong at everything. When you apply, you'll rate yourself in each area and tell us your strongest and weakest skills. If short-form clips or design (thumbnails, Reel covers) aren't your strength, that's fine: you can quote for the long form and trailer only, and we'll give the rest to someone else.



The look is Vogue: sophisticated, editorial, bright and clean. The pace is Hot Smart Rich podcast: light, commercial and easy to listen to while driving, doing your make-up or pushing a buggy.





WHAT YOU'LL RECEIVE FOR EACH EPISODE



Everything is shared through 
. We will give you a brief with transcript notes, so you won't build the editorial structure from scratch, but we want your creative eye to improve the pacing and spot extra moments that could do well on social.



- Raw interview footage: two camera angles and separate host and guest audio tracks (about 60 minutes)

- A full transcript with timestamps

- Jada's edit notes: running order, planned cuts, chapter structure, suggested social moments with timecodes, and any sensitive sections that must stay long-form only or never be clipped

- Jada's trailer intro (one continuous piece to camera) and the key moments to cut into it

- The CEO MUM CTA outro (video and audio), reused every episode

- Music: our licensed CEO MUM jingle and stems

- The editor library in 
 > ASSETS: fonts, logos, music licence, white studio thumbnail background and templates

- The full Editor's Brief, with running orders, specs and examples





1. EDITING (TOP PRIORITY)



The full episode (16:9)

- Cut about 60 minutes down to about 40 minutes, never more than 50

- Multi-camera edit: sync the separate audio tracks and both cameras

- Restructure the story: open on the strongest moment, then tell the guest's story in order. The order of the interview is never the order of the edit

- After Jada signs off in 
, export two versions: Spotify (CEO MUM watermark top right) and YouTube (completely clean)



The trailer

- 30–60 seconds, every episode: Jada's intro cut at natural pauses, with interview moments dropped in, ending on the strongest line

- Delivered at 16:9 (opens the full episode) and 9:16 (Clip 01 on social, with the CEO MUM logo and subtitles)



Social clips (9:16, for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts) (if you take on clips)

- 10 clips per episode: the trailer clip plus 9 key moments. Length depends on the moment, usually 30–90 seconds

- Subtitles: phrase by phrase (2–4 words). Every word checked against the audio, names spelt correctly





2. SOUND (ESSENTIAL)



Sound is one of our three priorities, and we'll test it closely on the trial. Please only apply if you're confident producing a finished professional podcast audio master, not just adjusting volume levels.





3. COLOUR GRADE AND SKIN (ESSENTIAL)



The grade is a big part of the CEO MUM look, and we'll judge it as closely as the edit and the sound. We need someone with real colour grading skills, not someone who only applies a preset or LUT.





4. THUMBNAILS AND COVERS (WANTED, BUT CAN GO TO SOMEONE ELSE)



Tell us honestly how strong you are here and send examples. If design isn't your strength, we can give this part to someone else.

- YouTube thumbnails

- Instagram Reel covers





THE EDITING STYLE



CEO MUM is conversational, premium, warm and honest. We want the pace of a strong modern interview podcast: engaging and tight, without feeling over-edited.



Hard no's: manufactured controversy or misleading edits, generic clickbait headlines, the spoken guest welcome at the start, constant zooms or jump cuts, meme sounds or swooshes, trend effects, emojis on screen, heavy-outline or all-caps subtitles, the spinning logo animation, stock footage or B-roll (unless Jada supplies it), and unlicensed music, fonts or stock.



We write the social captions, show notes and publishing copy. Your main job is excellent video and audio.



ATTENTION TO DETAIL: to show you've read the whole ad, put the word EDITOR in the subject line of your application. We may not review applications without it.





WHAT YOU DELIVER PER EPISODE



- Full episode with watermark (Spotify): MP4 16:9, 1920x1080, end card on

- Full episode, clean (YouTube): MP4 16:9, 1920x1080, end card on

- Trailer: 30–60 seconds, MP4 16:9 and 9:16

- Audio episode: WAV 48 kHz 24-bit master + MP3 (192 kbps or higher)



Video: H.264, frame rate matched to the camera, AAC audio at 48 kHz.



Additional but not essential:

- 9 clips with copy (logo + subtitles): MP4 9:16, 1080x1920

- 9 clips, completely clean: MP4 9:16, 1080x1920

- 3 YouTube thumbnail options: JPG/PNG 1280x720, under 2 MB

- 10 Instagram Reel covers: PNG 1080x1920





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Essential

- Professional experience editing podcasts or long-form interviews

- Multi-camera video editing

- Strong audio cleanup, mixing and mastering

- Strong colour correction, grading and camera matching, with natural skin retouching

- A good understanding of pacing, storytelling and audience retention

- The ability to follow transcript-based edit notes accurately

- Fluent written English and excellent attention to detail

- Reliable communication and deadlines

- Good headphones or studio monitors, and internet fast enough for large files (episodes can be 5 GB or more)

- 
 or a similar review platform



Useful tools include Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, Adobe Audition, Fairlight, Auphonic and iZotope RX, or equivalents.



Nice to have

- Motion graphics (After Effects or similar)

- High-quality Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts, with clean subtitles and on-screen text

- Thumbnail and cover design (Photoshop, Canva or similar)

- Experience with women's, lifestyle, parenting or business content

- A strong instinct for social media moments





WORKING ARRANGEMENT



- Remote and freelance, paid per completed episode package (not hourly)

- The upcoming season has 10 episodes, roughly two a month. This isn't guaranteed and depends on our recording schedule

- Paid trial: we'll choose one editor to edit one full episode to the complete brief, paid at the same rate as ongoing work

- Turnaround: 10 days from receiving the footage to the first full delivery

- About 2–3 revision rounds per episode, especially while we establish the style

- All reviews and sign-off happen in 
. Nothing goes final until Jada signs off the long-form edit

- You'll sign a freelance contract and a confidentiality agreement. CEO MUM owns all footage and deliverables

- We want to build a long-term relationship with the right editor, with ongoing work after the season





HOW TO APPLY



Put EDITOR in your subject line and send us:



1. Portfolio: 2–3 long-form podcast or interview edits that you personally edited, and 3–5 vertical Reels, TikToks or Shorts (if you do short-form). Please send your most relevant work, not a large general portfolio

2. Sound: a before-and-after audio sample, or an episode where you handled the full mix and master

3. Grade: before-and-after stills (ungraded and graded) from a two-camera interview you've graded, ideally including skin retouching

4. Design (if you do it): examples of thumbnails or Reel covers

5. Your experience: where you're based and your time zone, how many years you've professionally edited podcasts, and the software you use for video editing, colour grading, and audio cleanup, mixing and mastering

6. Your self-rating: rate yourself from 1 (beginner) to 5 (expert) in each area below, then tell us your two strongest and two weakest areas. Honesty helps: if clips or design aren't your thing, we can give them to someone else

   - Long-form editing and story structure: _/5

   - Multi-camera editing and syncing: _/5

   - Sound: cleanup, mixing and mastering: _/5

   - Colour grade and skin retouching: _/5

   - Trailer editing: _/5

   - Vertical clips and reframing: _/5

   - Subtitles and on-screen text: _/5

   - Intro animation and motion graphics: _/5

   - YouTube thumbnails: _/5

   - Instagram Reel covers: _/5



7. Your rate, in USD:



Option A, full package: a fixed rate for

- 1 x long-form episode (both versions)

- 1 x mixed and mastered audio

- 1 x edited trailer (16:9 and 9:16)

- 9 x clips for social media (each with copy and clean)

- 3 x YouTube thumbnail options

- 10 x Instagram Reel covers

- 2–3 revision rounds



Option B, long form only: a fixed rate for

- 1 x long-form episode (both versions)

- 1 x mixed and mastered audio

- 1 x edited trailer (16:9 and 9:16)

- 2–3 revision rounds



8. Season rate: whether you'd offer a different rate for the full 10-episode season, for both options



9. Turnaround: your usual turnaround for one episode package and your current availability

title: Short-Form Content Creator: Trial Reels for @jadasezer (Freelance, Remote)
description:
You will be working for Jada Sezer, a London-based content creator, founder and mum, and looking for a freelance short-form creator to make and schedule Instagram trial reels for her personal 
 reels are shown to people who don't follow her yet, so every reel has one job: stop the scroll, say something true about motherhood, and bring new people back to follow her.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Create 5 trial reels a week 

- Each reel is a short B-roll clip (around 5 seconds) with text on screen and a caption, all about motherhood

- Write your own text on screen: relatable, honest, sometimes funny, always warm. Jada will also send you lines of her own to use

- Reuse B-roll: the same clip can be used more than once with different text on top

- Write the caption for each reel, ending with our standard follow line (we will give you this; it stays the same every time)

- Schedule all 5 reels each week in a secure scheduling tool of your choice

- Keep a simple weekly log of what went out and how each reel performed (views, follows)





WHAT I'LL SEND YOU



- B-roll of simple, everyday moments from my life, sent over WhatsApp, shared Apple folder or Google Drive.

- Text-on-screen ideas when she has them

- The standard follow line for the captions

- Examples of the look and tone I like





THE STYLE

- Clean and simple: the B-roll does the setting, the words do the work

- Text on screen that's easy to read on a phone, placed clear of faces and inside Instagram's safe zones

- Real, warm and on the side of mums, never preachy, mum-shaming or clickbait

- UK spelling throughout. It's always "mum", never "mom"

- No emoji overload, no stock footage





HOW WE WORK

- We communicate on WhatsApp, so you'll need to be quick and reliable there

- You schedule in your own tool, but it must be secure: two-factor authentication on, and access to Jada's account never shared with anyone else

- Reels are scheduled at least a few days ahead, so there's always something in the queue





WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



Essential

- Experience creating Instagram Reels with text on screen

- A strong instinct for hooks: you know what makes someone stop scrolling

- Excellent written English and a good ear for a short, punchy line

- Organised and consistent: 5 reels, every week, on time

- Experience with a scheduling tool (Meta Business Suite, Later, Metricool, Planoly or similar)



Nice to have

- You're a mum, or you know the mum audience well

- Experience with Instagram trial reels

- Experience growing a personal brand or creator account





ATTENTION TO DETAIL

Put TRIAL REELS in your subject line. Applications without it may not be reviewed.





HOW TO APPLY



Send me:

1. A short intro: where you're based and your time zone

2. 3–5 Reels you've made with text on screen (links are fine)

3. 5 text-on-screen lines you'd put on a 5-second clip of a mum making a coffee while the house is chaos. This is the most important part of your application

4. Which scheduling tool you use and how you keep client accounts secure

5. Your rate for 5 trial reels a week (per week or per month), uploading, adding captions and your availability

title: Graphic Designer
description:
# Graphic Designer - Amazon Listings, A+ Content & Social Media (Part-Time)



Company: Yakatoshi & Co.



Location: Remote (Philippines)



Salary:  USD per hour, depending on experience



Application Deadline: 48 Hours



Hours: 10 hours per week (flexible schedule)



Employment: Part-time, long-term opportunity



### About Us



Yakatoshi & Co. is a premium Japanese-inspired travel accessories brand, currently focused on our innovative collapsible cabin suitcase.



We sell primarily in the United States through Amazon and our own Shopify website.



We are looking for an experienced, creative and commercially minded graphic designer to improve our Amazon product listings and produce engaging graphics for our Instagram page.



We are not simply looking for someone who can make attractive graphics. We want someone who understands how to use design to sell products.



### Your Responsibilities



### Phase 1 - Amazon Listing Optimisation (First Week)



Your first assignment will be to redesign and improve the graphics for our Amazon product listing, including our A+ Content.



We expect this initial project to be completed within your first 10 working hours, using our existing professional product photography.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Creating premium Amazon product listing images, including infographics, lifestyle images, feature highlights and comparison graphics.

- Designing high-quality Amazon A+ Content that communicates our product's unique selling points.

- Independently researching successful suitcase and travel accessory listings on Amazon for inspiration.

- Identifying the most important customer benefits and translating them into engaging visuals.

- Writing concise, persuasive English copy that highlights the product's benefits.

- Professionally editing and enhancing our existing product photography.

- Ensuring all graphics meet Amazon's image requirements.

- Maintaining a consistent premium brand identity across all designs.



We will provide access to our professional product photography and existing brand assets.



We expect you to bring your own creative ideas, conduct research independently and recommend improvements. We will not provide detailed instructions for every graphic.



Our goal is to have the complete Amazon listing graphics and A+ Content ready for upload by the end of your first week.



### Phase 2 - Social Media & Marketing Graphics (Week 2 Onwards)



Once the Amazon listing has been completed, your primary responsibility will shift towards producing high-quality graphics for our Instagram page and other marketing channels.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Creating visually engaging Instagram posts and carousel graphics.

- Developing creative concepts that showcase our products and their benefits.

- Designing educational, promotional and lifestyle-focused content.

- Creating seasonal and holiday promotional graphics.

- Producing graphics for occasional website updates and marketing campaigns.

- Researching successful travel, lifestyle and premium consumer brands for inspiration.

- Proactively suggesting new content ideas that could increase engagement and attract potential customers.



We want someone who can take ownership of our visual content and consistently produce creative, high-quality work without needing constant direction.



You will work approximately 10 hours per week, and we expect you to manage your time efficiently while maintaining professional design standards.



### Requirements



- At least 2 years of professional graphic design experience, preferably working with Amazon sellers or e-commerce brands.

- Advanced Photoshop skills, including photo manipulation and realistic product compositing.

- Experience creating graphics for Instagram and Meta advertisements.

- A strong portfolio demonstrating premium, professional graphic design.

- Experience designing Amazon product listing images and A+ Content.

- Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or equivalent professional design software.

- Excellent written English, including grammar, spelling and marketing copywriting.

- An understanding of consumer psychology, product positioning and conversion-focused design.

- Ability to independently research competitors and develop creative ideas.

- Excellent attention to detail and strong time management skills.

- Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

- Reliable communication and the ability to meet agreed deadlines.



### Working Arrangements



- 10 hours per week.

- Flexible working hours.

- Fully remote.

- Competitive hourly pay based on experience.

- Opportunity for a long-term working relationship.

- Potential for additional hours as the business grows.



We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work, meets deadlines and consistently delivers high-quality results.



All completed work must be supplied in the correct dimensions, together with editable source files.



### How to Apply



Please send your application to:







 subject: Yakatoshi Graphic Designer Application



Your application must include:



1. Your portfolio showcasing previous graphic design projects, preferably Amazon listing images and A+ Content.

2. Your answers to the application questions below.

3. One original Amazon A+ Content graphic created specifically for our Yakatoshi collapsible suitcase, following the instructions in the Design Assessment section.



Applications without a design submission will not be considered.



### Application Questions



1. Have you previously designed Amazon product listing images or A+ Content? Please share examples of your work, particularly projects you designed independently.



2. If you had 10 working hours, approximately how many high-quality graphics could you produce?



3. Imagine you were tasked with improving our collapsible suitcase listing. How would you research competing products on Amazon, identify our strongest selling points and d
 what graphics to create?



4. In your opinion, what separates an attractive Amazon product image from one that actually helps convert visitors into paying customers?



5. How many high-quality Instagram graphics could you realistically produce in 10 hours, including research, design and revisions? Please distinguish between individual posts and carousel posts.



6. Which graphic design software do you use? Do you use AI-assisted design tools, and if so, how do you ensure the final images accurately represent the product?



7. How confident are you writing short, persuasive marketing copy in English? Are you comfortable writing and proofreading your own copy without being given exact wording?



8. Can you share an example of a design project where you independently developed the creative concept rather than simply following detailed instructions?



### Mandatory Design Assessment - Submit With Your Application



As part of your application, you must design and submit one original Amazon A+ premium Content graphic for our Yakatoshi collapsible suitcase. **[1464px x 600px]**



This is an opportunity to demonstrate your creativity, technical ability, understanding of e-commerce design and ability to work independently.



Our Amazon product listing:




](



Our Google Drive photography and content bank:







Your task:



1. Review our Amazon product listing to understand the product and its features.

2. Research other successful suitcase brands on Amazon to identify effective A+ Content design styles.

3. Independently some of our product's key selling points that you believe would appeal most to potential customers.

4. Create one premium, professional A+ Content graphic highlighting that selling point.

5. Use the product photography provided in our Google Drive folder.

6. Write your own short, persuasive marketing copy in English.

7. Submit your finished design as a high-resolution JPG or PNG, together with a brief explanation of why you chose that particular selling point and design approach.



We are deliberately not providing detailed creative instructions. We want to see how you approach the task independently.



Your design should reflect the premium, Japanese-inspired identity of Yakatoshi & Co. while clearly communicating the benefits of the product.



The product must be represented accurately. Please do not invent features, specifications or product details that are not supported by our listing or photography.



You may use AI-assisted tools, but the final design must be professional, realistic, accurate and free from obvious AI-generated errors.



This is a single-graphic application assessment, not a request to redesign the entire listing. You may watermark your submission.



We will evaluate submissions based on:



- Overall design quality and premium appearance.

- Creativity and originality.

- Ability to identify and communicate relevant customer benefits.

- Understanding of Amazon A+ Content and conversion-focused design.

- Quality of English copywriting, including spelling and grammar.

- Attention to detail and product accuracy.

- Ability to independently research, develop and execute a creative concept.



The assessment is unpaid and will be used only to evaluate applications. We will not publish or commercially use submitted work without separate agreement.



### Final Note



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the creative process, not simply follow instructions.



If you enjoy creating premium graphics that help products stand out and sell, we would love to hear from you.

title: IT Manager
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



In a company with no office, IT is the office. Every laptop, login, tool, and file is how the whole team gets to work, and the whole business runs on it. When it works, nobody notices. When it fails, the whole team stops. Every new hire, tool, and market adds more to look after, and the companies that keep growing are the ones where someone owns it.



This role owns it, and leads the team that makes it work. You’ll keep our systems secure, our tools running, and our people productive, wherever in the world they log in from. You’ll set the standards, guide the IT team, and make sure new teammates are set up in a day, gaps are closed before anyone finds them, and the technology behind the business is something the rest of the team never has to think about.



For a sharp, driven technology leader who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: a central role in how a growing brand runs.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Lead the IT team. Set clear priorities, divide the work, and give your team what it needs to do it well. You’ll coach people, review their work, and build a team that solves problems without waiting to be told.



Own the tech stack. Know every tool, account, and integration we run, who uses it, what it costs, and what depends on it. Choose and set up new tools well, and retire the ones we don’t need.



Keep us secure. Set the standard and make sure it’s followed: strong authentication, access controls, password management, device security, and clear rules for who can reach what. Teach the whole company to spot threats before they click.



Make onboarding and offboarding flawless. Make sure every new hire has working accounts, devices, and access on day one, and that every door closes the moment someone leaves.



Run a help desk that people love. Make sure problems across time zones are solved quickly, track the issues that keep coming back, and fix their causes for good.



Protect our data. Make sure backups are reliable, recovery is tested, and customer and company data is handled in line with the privacy rules in every market we sell in.



Look after our digital foundations. Keep our domains,
, website infrastructure, and tracking healthy, so our store stays up and our
s reach the inbox.



Automate the repetitive work. Build, or have your team build, the scripts, workflows, and integrations that save everyone hours.



Bring in AI safely. Evaluate and set up AI tools for the company, with clear guidance on what data can and can’t go into them.



Control the costs. Audit subscriptions and licenses, catch waste and billing errors, and work with vendors to bring costs down.



Write it down. Make sure how things work and how to fix them is documented, so nothing lives only in one person’s head.



Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI tools to speed up troubleshooting, scripting, and routine work, then apply your own judgment to make the final calls.



What we look for



Leadership people want to follow. You set a clear direction, delegate well, and give honest feedback that helps people improve. You hold a high bar without micromanaging, and you stay close enough to the work to help when it gets hard.



A security mindset. You think about how things could go wrong before they do, and you build habits and safeguards that hold up in practice, not only on paper.



Practical problem solving. You find the real cause fast, fix it cleanly, and learn something from every issue. You’re happy to dig into the unfamiliar.



Judgment under pressure. You stay steady when something breaks, make sound calls with incomplete information, and keep people informed while your team fixes it.



Clear communication. You can explain technical things to non-technical people in plain words, and your instructions leave no one guessing.



Ownership. You treat every system and every problem as yours until it’s solved. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [4+] years in IT management, systems administration, or a similar role, including [2+] years leading an IT team, ideally supporting remote or distributed teams at a growing company, with results you can show. Experience in e-commerce or consumer brands is a strong advantage. Excellent English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact across the business. Every person on the team uses what you and your team build and maintain. You’ll see the whole company work better because of it.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the person who builds our technology foundations and the team behind them is the person best placed to lead it.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you’ll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we’ll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don’t talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Security Lead (Application and Infrastructure Security), Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
Quick note: Before sending in your application, please make sure to read all the instructions in our "How to Apply" section. Any applications with missing items from our instructions will not be entertained.



ABOUT MSTR



MSTR is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. Our clients include municipalities, accountants, law firms and enterprise companies.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Security work is currently shared by our infra and DevOps teams, alongside their main jobs. We want one person to own it end to end, set the standard, and be able to block a release.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. You start as our security lead and build this into a small department over time.



LOCATION AND WORKING SET-UP

- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 3:00 p.m - 12:00 a.m Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Dependency and supply-chain hygiene across all repos: Dependabot or Renovate, npm/pip/NuGet audits, SBOMs, a fixed patch cadence, and triaging what is actually exploitable

- Pentesting our own products and the custom builds for clients, before release and on a recurring schedule

- Security checks in CI: SAST, secrets scanning, container and IaC scanning, and DAST against staging

- Cloud and platform posture on Azure and Supabase: identity and access, row-level security (RLS), network exposure, key management

- AI-specific risks: prompt injection, MCP and tool permissions, data leaking through LLM calls, and which model providers may see client data

- Own i
 response and a vulnerability disclosure process

- Support enterprise security questionnaires and compliance (GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001 readiness)

- Build security into a small department over time and set the rules the developers follow



HOW WE SPLIT THE WORK

- DevOps runs the platform. Security sets policy, finds issues, checks the fixes, and has veto on releases.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must-have:

- At least 4 years in application security or pentesting, with real findings you can walk us through

- Strong grip on the OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP LLM Top 10

- Hands-on with Burp Suite or similar

- Can read and fix code in our stacks: TypeScript/React/Next, Python, .NET, Postgres

- Azure security experience

- Supabase experience

- You write clear findings that a developer can act on and a client can read

- You take ownership without being chased. This is a lead role, not an assistant role.

- Excellent English communication, written and verbal



Nice-to-have:

- OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or an Azure security certification

- A bug bounty track record

- Has gone through ISO 27001 or SOC 2 with a company

- Has used Claude Code for security review



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, Claude Code or similar tools for code review or security work, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- Build something from scratch: you set up the security function, with direct access to the leadership team

- Real authority: you have veto on releases

- Interesting problems: application, infrastructure and AI security in one role

- A clear growth path: build and lead a small security department

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



OUR STACK

- Cloud and platform: Azure, Supabase

- Languages and frameworks: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, .NET

- Database: Postgres



HOW TO APPLY

IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into application security.

2. A finding you are proud of: Walk us through a real vulnerability you found. How did you find it, what was the impact, and how did you get it fixed? Leave out anything confidential.

3. Stopping a release: Tell us about a time you had to say "this can't go live yet". How did you explain it, and how did you get the team on your side?

4. Securing AI: An AI assistant at a client can read their documents and use tools through MCP. What are the main risks, including which model providers may see client data, and what would you check first?

5. Your next role: What would you like to achieve in your next role? Where do you see yourself in 5 to 10 years?



Video guidelines:

- Length: 3 to 7 minutes in total

- Production: no need for professional quality, we want to see the real you

- Authenticity: it's fine to use AI to prepare, but talk to us in your own words. Please don't read from a script.

- Language: English (this assesses your communication skills)

- Format: any video format is fine (MP4, MOV, etc.)

- Hosting: upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube (unlisted) or similar



Step 2: Submit your application

Send the following to 
 and 



1. Your video (link or attachment)

2. Your CV / resume

3. Optional: certifications, bug bounty profile, GitHub, LinkedIn, or an anonymized finding report you wrote



 subject: "Security Lead Application - [Your Name]"



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

1. We review your video and CV within 2 to 3 days

2. If you are a strong match, we schedule an initial interview

3. Successful candidates move to a technical evaluation

4. Final candidates meet with our founder

5. We aim to complete the entire process in 1 to 2 weeks



WHO SHOULD APPLY

Apply if you:

- Want a long-term career in a high-performance organization

- Like setting up structure where there is none yet

- Take ownership without being chased

- Are curious about AI and the new security risks it brings



Don't apply if you:

- Only want short-term gigs or are juggling multiple clients

- Aren't willing to create a video response

- Don't have hands-on application security or pentesting experience



Ready to apply? Send your video and CV to 
 and 
 are happy to answer any questions.



We look forward to learning more about you.
