title: Crypto BD Lead Wanted: Turn DeFi Contacts Into Booked Calls, Get Paid Per Call + Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: Content Coordinator & Short-Form Video Editor
description:
**Part-Time Content Coordinator & Video Editor — Potential for Full-Time**



We’re an American-led sourcing and supply business based in Guangzhou, China, working across three brands: Customise, Crew Stock, and ZA.



We’re looking for a self-sufficient content coordinator who can research topics, plan shoots, edit videos, and schedule approved content across Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube.



**Hours & compensation**



- Approximately 20 hours per week initially.

- Budget: $450–$550 USD per month, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.

- Potential to grow into a full-time position based on performance and business needs.

All content requires our approval before publishing.

4. How many original short-form videos you could realistically plan, edit, and prepare for publishing within 20 hours per week, while also handling the coordination and scheduling responsibilities above. Explain your assumptions about video length, editing complexity, and supplied footage.

title: Store Manager
description:
ABOUT US



Rueger Rose is our Scandinavian jewelry brand: handcrafted, 100% waterproof gold and silver jewelry, made to be worn every day, in the shower and in the sea.



We sell on 
 across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, the UK and Finland. We launch new products every week and test them fast.



The store needs one person who owns it day to day and keeps it running smoothly, so the brand team can focus on ads and growth.



You are hired by Vaunt Partners and placed on Rueger Rose. You start hands-on, doing the work yourself. As the store scales, you will help hire and train the people who take tasks off your plate.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



THE ROLE



You own the Rueger Rose store. That means:



✔ Every product is listed properly, looks right and is live where it should be.

✔ When something needs to change, you spot it, raise it and get it done.

✔ Nothing slips through the cracks.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



WHAT YOU WILL DO



▸ PRODUCT LISTINGS



• List new jewelry on Shopify:

   - photos, titles, descriptions, details, care guides, materials and sizes

   - prices and variants per metal (gold, silver, rose gold)

   - collections and Swedish, Danish and Norwegian translations

   - publishing to every sales channel

• Keep every product's status up to date in our Notion product database, from "Want To Test" to "Listed".

• Find winning products: study what scaling jewelry brands run in the Meta Ad Library and Foreplay, then find the same piece on Alibaba.

• Check every product before it goes live. It must be waterproof and tarnish-free (stainless steel, no copper, brass or pearl), and the materials, plating and sizes must match the listing.

• Fill in product data and specs, and flag anything unclear to the supplier.

• Run product photo shoots with Claude and Kive (our AI image tool), and check every image against the real product:

   - same model, one outfit per product

   - true scale on the body and the right stone count

   - "close" is not good enough

• Keep images and assets organised in 
.



▸ WEBSITE HEALTH



• Check 
 every day in every market: product pages, collections, cart, checkout, the buy 1 get 1 free offer, discounts, mobile and desktop.

• Catch broken links, wrong prices, missing images, out-of-date offers and translation errors before customers do.

• Test new theme changes and offers before they go live.



▸ CHANGES AND IMPROVEMENTS



• Keep a running list of what needs to change on the store and why.

• Raise issues and suggestions to the brand lead, with screenshots and a clear fix.

• Make the changes you can make yourself (content, listings, collections, settings) and follow up on the rest until they are done.



▸ KEEPING THINGS RUNNING



• Keep the store tidy:

   - collections (necklaces, bracelets, rings, earrings, Birthstone Collection, Gold Edit, Silver Edit, New In)

   - tags, filters and product order

   - sold-out and dropped products

• Keep processes and checklists up to date so anyone can follow them.



▸ LATER: BUILDING THE TEAM



• As the store grows, help recruit, onboard and train people to take over your tasks.

• Turn what you do into simple processes others can follow.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



WHAT YOU BRING



▸ MUST HAVE



• Experience working on Shopify stores for DTC brands. You have listed products, managed collections and fixed store issues before.

• Very comfortable in the Shopify admin:

   - products, variants, collections and metafields

   - markets, translations and discounts

   - themes (enough to test and spot problems)

• You use AI tools every day, especially Claude. You give clear instructions and check the output.

• You learn new tools fast: Notion, 
, Kive, ad libraries and Alibaba.

• Experience finding products and suppliers on Alibaba or similar, and judging quality and materials from a listing.

• An eye for detail. You notice a wrong price, a blurry photo, an extra stone or a broken link straight away.

• Organised and reliable. You keep track of many listings without being chased.

• Clear written English.



▸ NICE TO HAVE



• Experience with jewelry or fashion accessories brands.

• Swedish, Danish or Norwegian, for checking translations.

• Basic knowledge of Liquid or theme editing.

• Experience with Meta ads, product testing or running a store end to end.

• Experience hiring or training others.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



TOOLS YOU WILL USE



Shopify • Claude (Claude Code and claude.ai) • Notion • 
 • Kive • Alibaba • Meta Ad Library • Foreplay



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through this form (applications outside the form are not reviewed):

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

title: Part-Time B2B Sales Outreach & Lead Qualification Representative — US Hours
description:
**Part-Time B2B Sales Outreach & Lead Qualification Representative — US Hours**



**Location:** Remote  

**Pay:** $6–$7 USD/hour, depending on experience, plus performance bonuses  

**Hours:** 27 hours per week  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9 AM–2 PM US Eastern; Saturday, 10 AM–12 PM US Eastern  

**Start:** Paid 30-day trial, with the goal of a long-term role



**About us**



Customise helps established businesses source custom packaging, retail supplies, and branded products through our China-based sourcing team and factory partners.



We’re looking for a proactive sales representative who can find suitable business customers, start conversations, respond to inquiries, and collect requirements for our sourcing team to prepare quotes.



This role combines outbound prospecting with inbound lead handling. You must be comfortable making live calls to US businesses.



**Responsibilities**



- Research potential customers through Instagram, business websites, and other relevant sources.

- Review videos and accounts we provide, identify suitable business buyers, and find additional prospects independently.

- Make outbound calls and send personalized outreach through approved channels.

- Answer incoming calls and messages promptly during your shift.

- Follow up with interested prospects, previous inquiries, and outstanding quotes.

- Collect product specifications, quantities, delivery location, timeline, and artwork status.

- Qualify prospects against our minimum order requirements.

- Maintain accurate contact records, conversation notes, and follow-up tasks in GoHighLevel.

- Coordinate with our sourcing team and keep customers informed.

- Submit a brief daily report covering activity, qualified opportunities, and next steps.



Saturday hours will primarily focus on incoming inquiries and follow-ups. Our sourcing team handles supplier research and final pricing; you must not make unapproved pricing or delivery promises.



**Requirements**



- At least one year of relevant B2B sales, outbound calling, appointment-setting, or lead-qualification experience.

- Clear, easily understood spoken English and strong written English.

- Confidence speaking with US business owners and handling objections.

- A natural, conversational communication style.

- Strong research skills and good judgment about which businesses are suitable prospects.

- Experience using a CRM and maintaining organized follow-ups.

- Reliable availability for the full schedule, including Saturdays.

- Quiet workspace, quality headset, stable internet, and a practical backup connectivity/power plan.

- Respect for customer confidentiality and company account security.



GoHighLevel experience is preferred. Packaging, sourcing, manufacturing, or retail experience is a plus.



**Schedule details**



The schedule follows US Eastern time and changes with US daylight saving time.



For applicants in the Philippines:



- **US standard time:** Monday–Friday, 10 PM–3 AM the following day; Saturday, 11 PM–1 AM the following day.

- **US daylight saving time:** Monday–Friday, 9 PM–2 AM the following day; Saturday, 10 PM–12 midnight.



**Performance bonuses**



In addition to hourly pay:



- **$10 per new qualified opportunity** accepted by our sourcing team.

- **An additional $50** when that prospect’s first order of at least **$2,000 USD** is paid in full.



A qualified opportunity must be a genuine business buyer who meets our minimum order requirement, provides the necessary buying information, and requests a quote. Unanswered outreach, duplicate contacts, and existing inquiries do not qualify for the new-opportunity bonus.



Detailed qualification, attribution, and bonus payment terms will be agreed before starting.



**How to apply**



Please include:



1. Your résumé and a short description of your relevant B2B sales experience.

2. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining how you would approach a retail store about custom packaging.

3. A brief example of how you handled the objection: “We already have a supplier.”

4. The CRM and calling tools you have used.

5. Your location, requested hourly rate, earliest start date, and confirmation that you can consistently work the stated schedule.

6. A brief description of your workspace and backup internet/power arrangements.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a live mock call and a short paid research and CRM exercise.

title: Junior Accountant
description:
Company Overview

We are a small, growing accounting and business services firm based in Coulsdon, UK. We support clients with bookkeeping, accounting and financial compliance, alongside outsourced business administration and process management services. Our focus is on building long-term client relationships and delivering a consistently high standard of service.



Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support our team with ongoing client bookkeeping and the preparation of accounts up to year-end review stage.

We need someone who can independently manage bookkeeping for multiple clients, investigate discrepancies and prepare accurate accounts and supporting working papers for review by our accountant.

The role will also involve coordinating client work, support other bookkeeping colleagues and help improve our processes.



Role Objectives

• Ensure allocated client accounts are accurate, fully reconciled and completed within agreed deadlines.

• Prepare client records and supporting schedules ready for year-end accounts preparation.

• Keep clients and the Business Manager informed of progress, outstanding information and any issues requiring attention.

• Help maintain clear, consistent bookkeeping procedures and identify opportunities to improve efficiency.

• Support the quality and timely completion of work undertaken by junior bookkeeping colleagues.



Key Responsibilities

• Maintaining accurate client records in Xero and QuickBooks Online, including sales invoices, purchase invoices, expenses and receipts.

• Reconciling bank accounts, credit cards and payment platforms, including multi-currency transactions where applicable.

• Reviewing sales and purchase ledgers, allocating payments, investigating outstanding balances and supporting credit control where required.

• Reconciling accounting records against booking systems, spreadsheets and other client records to identify missing or incorrect entries.

• Reconciling balance sheet accounts, including VAT, payroll liabilities, loans and directors’ loan accounts.

• Preparing and posting journals, including payroll, accruals, prepayments and depreciation, with supporting calculations.

• Preparing VAT workings and draft returns for review.

• Reviewing profit and loss reports and balance sheets, investigating unusual transactions and discussing potential errors with the Business Manager.

• Preparing a fully reconciled trial balance, year-end schedules and supporting working papers for the accountant’s review.

• Preparing regular reconciliation reports and supporting monthly financial reporting, including budget comparisons where required.

• Following up on missing information and keeping clients informed of queries and progress.

• Planning and tracking allocated client work in line with agreed workflows and deadlines.

• Creating and updating client-specific standard operating procedures (SOPs), including documenting recurring tasks and reviewing procedures when requirements change.

• Identifying process issues and suggesting practical improvements to reduce errors and save time.

• Supporting junior bookkeepers by reviewing assigned tasks, answering routine queries and sharing process guidance.

• Assisting with client onboarding and occasional finance-related administrative tasks as required.



Key Skills / Capabilities / Behaviours

• Proven experience managing bookkeeping for multiple clients, ideally within an accountancy practice.

• Experience working with UK client accounts and a good understanding of UK bookkeeping and VAT.

• Demonstrated ability to prepare accounts through to trial balance and year-end review stage.

• Strong practical knowledge of Xero and/or QuickBooks Online.

• A sound understanding of double-entry bookkeeping, journals and balance sheet reconciliations.

• Excellent reconciliation skills and the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies.

• Confident Excel skills, including lookup formulas, SUMIF/SUMIFS, filters and pivot tables.

• Excellent attention to detail and a consistent approach to checking work.

• Good written and spoken English, with the ability to explain queries clearly to clients and colleagues.

• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage deadlines across several client accounts.

• Ability to learn client systems quickly and document processes clearly.

• Confidence working independently, using initiative and recognising when an issue requires the accountant’s input.

• A supportive, collaborative approach and willingness to help colleagues develop their skills.

• A professional approach to handling confidential client information.



Hours and Location

Hours of work: 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday

Location: Remote, Philippines.

You will need a reliable internet connection, a suitable computer and a quiet working environment.



Rate of Pay - negotiable based on experience

 



We also offer:

• Annual bonus based on personal and company performance 

• Contractors and team members are advised to keep 1-1 notes of progress and deliveries







Work requirements

• Good quality PC with 16GB ram 

• Two screens 1920x1080 (required for our inhouse systems)

• Headset

• Video camera – high resolution

title: Executive Assistant to CEO—-Electrical Contractor
description:
Executive Assistant to CEO— Electrical Contractor, USA



Company: Coharbor Electric LLC — Cape Coral / Fort Myers, Florida (USA)

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hrs/week, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (you must work USA business hours)

Location: 100% Remote — Philippines-based

Compensation: Depending on experience. Paid via Wise. Long-term, full-time role with room to grow as we double.

Start: As soon as we find the right person.





Who We Are



Coharbor Electric is a veteran-owned, Christian-owned residential and commercial electrical contractor serving Southwest Florida since 2010. We were founded by our CEO, Jacob Anderson — a Major in the U.S. Air Force — and we are a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Business. We do service work, panel and service changes, generator and EV-charger installs, new construction, and larger commercial projects including fire stations.



Our mission is simple and we mean it: "To provide high quality electrical work, on time, with integrity. Our purpose is to empower and lift up our employees, customers, partners, and fellow community members." We treat our customers the way we'd treat our own family, we use honest flat-rate pricing with no upsell scripts, and we live by a verse we keep in front of us: "Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord" (Colossians 3:23). We say we're "bringing light to a dark world," and we mean that about more than wiring.



That value — to empower and lift up our employees — is why this role exists. We are a team of about 20, and we intend to double. The thing slowing us down isn't demand; it's that too much runs through one desk. We're hiring a Chief of Staff to change that. Of our team of 20, we do have 5 employees in PH already. 



This is not a "send me tasks and I'll do them" job. This is a build-and-own job. We have a list of programs we've wanted to launch for a while and haven't had the bandwidth to build. Your job is to take them off the CEO's plate, build them, run them, and keep them running — and to organize the back office so leadership can stop living in the inbox.



If you want to be told exactly what to do every hour, this is the wrong role. If you see a mess and instinctively build the system that fixes it — and you want to work for a company whose word actually means something — keep reading.





What You'll Own



1. Inbox & Communication (the CEO should rarely touch email)





Take full ownership of the CEO's email inbox: triage, organize, label/folder, and clear it out.

Build a daily system: what needs the CEO, what you've handled, what's FYI.

Over your first 60–90 days, earn the trust to draft and then send routine replies on the CEO's behalf, reporting back in a single daily summary. The goal is simple: the CEO stops checking email.





2. Microsoft Teams — Organize It





Restructure Microsoft Teams: channels, files, naming conventions, and folder logic so the whole company can find what it needs.

Keep it organized as we grow.





3. Launch & Run Operational Programs (the core of this role)

You will build these from the ground up, document them, and then run them:





Installer Bonus Program — design and administer a performance bonus structure for our install crews.

Weekly Sales Tech Commissions — calculate and run sales technician commissions every week, accurately and on time.

Commercial Service Program — help stand up a recurring commercial service offering: the process, the workflow, the follow-up system.





4. Own the Hiring, Onboarding & Offboarding Process

We are doubling — you keep hiring organized and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. The CEO and our Technical Managers scan resumes and run the interviews; you own everything around that:





Post the jobs — write and publish job postings for open roles.

Schedule interviews — coordinate calendars and set up interviews between candidates and the CEO / Technical Managers.

Onboarding — once a candidate is hired, ensure 100% of onboarding paperwork is completed correctly and on time, and run them through the onboarding process.

Offboarding — when an employee parts ways, complete the offboarding paperwork and process accurately and discreetly.

Build and maintain the checklists and document templates that make onboarding and offboarding repeatable every single time.





5. Build Our Operating System (SOPs & Documentation)





Create SOPs, process documentation, templates, and operational systems — and do it for an electrical contracting business, where the details matter.

Turn "how we do things" out of the CEO's head and into written, repeatable systems.





6. Personal Assistant Support for the CEO

This role also supports the CEO personally. You will:





Book personal and business appointments and manage the CEO's calendar.

Set up and coordinate returns to retailers (initiate returns, schedule pickups, track refunds).

Categorize personal and family expenses and help maintain the family budget.

Handle other personal-assistant tasks as they come up — this person is a trusted right hand in both business and personal logistics.







What We Need From You



Required





3+ years supporting a CEO, founder, or executive as a Chief of Staff or high-level Executive Assistant — not a general/entry-level VA role.

Proven track record building systems, SOPs, and processes from scratch — please be ready to show examples of operational systems you have built.

Strong, professional written and spoken English. You will communicate on the CEO's behalf.

Comfort with numbers: you will run weekly commissions and a bonus program. Accuracy is non-negotiable.

Highly organized, proactive, and able to make sound decisions without being told.

Trustworthy and discreet — you will handle sensitive financial and personnel information.

Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional remote setup.

Able and willing to work USA Eastern business hours, full-time.





A Strong Plus (not required)





Experience with ServiceTitan and/or QuickBooks.

Experience supporting a trades, construction, electrical, HVAC, or home-services company.

HR, recruiting coordination, or employee onboarding/offboarding experience.

Comfort using AI tools to work faster.







How We Work



We are direct, we move fast, and we value people who take ownership and tell us the truth — including when we're wrong. As a faith-driven, veteran-owned company, integrity matters more to us than anything on your resume. You will handle sensitive financial and personnel information and represent the CEO in writing, so trustworthiness isn't a nice-to-have here — it's the whole job. We measure this role on outcomes: programs launched, inbox controlled, systems built. Do that well and this role grows with the company as we double.





How to Apply

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
# Executive Assistant to the CEO

**Mami Wander Media | Full-Time | Remote | Philippines**



**Compensation: $200 USD Weekly Base Salary + Up to $1,000 Quarterly Performance Bonuses**



Hi!



I'm looking for a highly experienced, extremely organized, and proactive Executive Assistant to work directly with me as the CEO of Mami Wander Media.



I'm looking for someone who can become my **right hand** — someone who helps me stay organized, manages my schedule, keeps track of everything happening across my company, and makes sure important tasks, projects, and deadlines never fall through the cracks.



I run a growing creator media company focused heavily on TikTok Shop affiliate content, along with content across Instagram,
, YouTube, and Threads.



We have a lot of moving parts, multiple projects, ongoing content production, team communications, deadlines, and daily priorities.



I need someone who can help me manage all of it.



**The most important thing I'm looking for is someone who is EXTREMELY organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and experienced in supporting a busy CEO or entrepreneur.**



I don't want to have to constantly remind someone what needs to get done. I want someone who can help remind ME, keep me accountable, anticipate what needs my attention, and make my day-to-day life easier.



### Important: TikTok Shop Affiliate Knowledge Is Required



Because TikTok Shop is such a major part of our business, you MUST have real experience or strong working knowledge of the TikTok Shop affiliate creator world.



You should understand:



- How TikTok Shop affiliate creators make money.

- The process of researching and selecting products to promote.

- How product samples, sample requests, and product collaborations work.

- The process of creating, organizing, and posting TikTok Shop affiliate videos.

- How products are linked to shoppable videos.

- How affiliate commissions, GMV, and content performance work.

- How TikTok Shop affiliate campaigns and creator workflows operate.

- The importance of posting consistency, content deadlines, and product deliverables.

- The general TikTok Shop creator ecosystem, including common platform challenges and opportunities.



**You do not need to be the person creating all of our content, running our TikTok Shop operations, or negotiating brand deals.**



However, you MUST understand this industry well enough to follow our projects, communicate with our team, understand what we're working on, and help me stay organized across all areas of the business.



If you have never worked in or closely supported the TikTok Shop affiliate creator industry, this position is not the right fit.



### Your Main Responsibilities



**1. Executive & Personal Assistance**



Your number one responsibility is helping me stay organized and operate efficiently as CEO.



- Manage my daily calendar, appointments, and meetings.

- Help organize my personal and professional schedules.

- Prepare my daily agenda and priorities.

- Remind me of important tasks, deadlines, and commitments.

- Help me plan my days, weeks, and upcoming projects.

- Organize my ideas and turn them into actionable tasks.

- Follow up with me on things that require my attention.

- Help me stay focused on high-priority activities.

- Anticipate scheduling conflicts and upcoming needs.



**2. Project & Task Management**



Mami Wander Media has multiple projects happening at the same time. I need someone who can help me keep track of everything.



- Organize and manage projects using Notion and 
.

- Maintain an accurate master list of ongoing projects and priorities.

- Track tasks, assignments, deadlines, and project progress.

- Follow up with team members on outstanding assignments.

- Make sure projects continue moving forward.

- Identify bottlenecks, delays, and unfinished tasks.

- Prepare project status updates for me.

- Help break larger projects into smaller actionable steps.

- Keep me informed about what is completed, pending, or requires my decision.



**3. Team Communication & Accountability**



- Help coordinate communication between me and the team.

- Monitor assigned 
 channels and communications.

- Follow up with team members regarding deliverables.

- Track deadlines and ensure assignments are not forgotten.

- Organize meeting notes and action items.

- Help prepare team meeting agendas.

- Send reminders and request status updates.

- Escalate important problems before they become bigger issues.



**4. Administrative Organization**



- Organize and manage Google Calendar, Gmail, Google Drive, Docs, and Sheets.

- Maintain organized company folders, files, and records.

- Create and update trackers, spreadsheets, and administrative documents.

- Help organize internal systems and workflows.

- Prepare summaries, reports, and presentations.

- Keep important company information accessible and organized.

- Handle confidential business and personal information with discretion.



**5. Media Company Coordination**



Because our business revolves around content creation and TikTok Shop affiliates, you'll also help me stay organized with:



- Content calendars and publishing schedules.

- TikTok Shop affiliate-related projects.

- Product and content deadlines.

- Team deliverables and ongoing campaigns.

- Administrative coordination across TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube, and Threads.

- Tracking outstanding items and identifying what needs my attention.



Your role is to help me oversee and organize these moving parts, not personally perform every specialized operational task.



Brand deal pricing and negotiation remain with me, while brand-facing outreach remains with our Operations Specialist.



### What I'm Looking For



I want someone who thinks ahead.



Someone who doesn't just wait for instructions but understands what needs to happen next.



For example:



If I mention an idea during a meeting, I want you to capture it, organize it, and help turn it into a project.



If I have an important deadline coming up, I want you reminding me before I even think about it.



If a team member hasn't completed something, I want you following up and letting me know what's happening.



If my schedule is becoming overwhelming, I want you helping me reorganize and prioritize it.



If there are 20 different projects happening, I want you to know where they all stand and what needs my attention.



**Ultimately, I want someone who helps bring structure, organization, and accountability to my day and to the company.**



### Non-Negotiable Requirements



- Minimum **5 years of experience** as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or similar executive support role.

- Strong working knowledge or direct experience in the TikTok Shop affiliate creator industry.

- Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

- Professional, fluent written and spoken English.

- Experience using Google Workspace, Notion, 
, and 
.

- Working knowledge of TikTok Shop and Meta social media platforms.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

- Strong follow-through and attention to detail.

- Proactive communication and independent problem-solving.

- Ability to work directly with a CEO and maintain confidentiality.

- Reliable daily attendance and early communication about any problems.

- Stable internet connection, personal computer, and backup internet or power plan.

- Ability to use a VPN for authorized work systems.

- Availability for 8 working hours per day, including a daily check-in during Pacific Time mornings.



### Compensation & Growth Opportunity



This is a long-term, full-time position.



**Compensation:**

- $200 USD per week base salary.

- Up to $1,000 USD in quarterly performance bonuses.

- Potential total annual compensation of $14,400 USD.

- Initial two-week paid trial with clearly defined expectations.



Quarterly bonuses will be based on performance, including organization, task completion, deadline management, communication, reliability, and executive support.



I'm looking for someone who wants to grow with Mami Wander Media and become an essential part of our leadership support structure.



### How to Apply



We expect to receive many applications, so please follow these instructions carefully.



Send ONE complete application
 to:







Your application MUST include:



1. **Resume:** Your updated resume highlighting your executive assistant experience.



2. **Portfolio:** Examples of organizational systems, calendars, project trackers, dashboards, or workflows you have personally created or managed. Remove all private or confidential information.



3. **TikTok Shop Experience:** A brief explanation of your experience with the TikTok Shop affiliate creator industry and the types of creators, teams, or businesses you have supported.



4. **Professional References:** At least two professional references, including name, position,
 address, and your working relationship. By submitting references, you authorize Mami Wander Media to contact them for professional verification.



5. **Introduction:** A short explanation of why you believe you would be an excellent Executive Assistant to the CEO.



6. **Software Experience:** Describe your proficiency with Google Workspace, Notion, 
, 
, TikTok Shop, and Meta social media.



7. **Availability:** Confirm your ability to work full-time, your availability for Pacific morning check-ins, and your earliest possible start date.



### Attention to Detail Test



To prove you read this entire posting, include the word **GLITTER** in the subject line of your application
.



Applications missing this word or any required application materials will not be considered.



Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a structured interview process, followed by a practical assessment and a two-week paid trial.



**I'm not simply looking to hire another assistant. I'm looking for someone who can become a trusted, dependable right hand and help me manage everything that comes with running and growing Mami Wander Media.**



If that sounds like you, I look forward to reviewing your application.

We are seeking a detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist representative. This role will be critical in acquiring, negotiating, and analyzing land deals for our sales pipeline.

Teach me in-depth website development from the ground up, with me writing the code myself

Explain the why behind every step so I understand how it all works under the hood

HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, at a deep level

VS Code, the terminal, and Node.js/npm

Using AI coding assistants like Claude Code to work faster



What I need from you



Real, proven experience building and deploying live websites from scratch. Send links and your GitHub.

Proficiency, not familiarity. I want a tutor who can go deep on every topic, not someone who only knows the basics.

Clear English and the ability to explain complex things simply to a beginner

IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



DO NOT APPLY unless you have previous, demonstrable experience working for a UK insulation, retrofit, energy-efficiency or closely related compliance-focused company.



We are NOT looking for a general virtual assistant who needs to learn the industry from scratch.



You must have practical experience managing installation administration, compliance documentation, customer job files and operational processes.



Experience with ECO4, PAS 2030, PAS 2035, TrustMark or similar UK retrofit programmes is highly desirable, but this is NOT an ECO4-specific role.



Applicants who cannot clearly demonstrate relevant industry experience will not be considered.



About Safe Eco-Fixes Ltd



Safe Eco-Fixes Ltd is a UK-based insulation and property improvement company specialising in cavity wall insulation, loft insulation, spray foam removal and associated property improvement services.



We are expanding our operations and developing structured administrative, quality assurance and compliance systems to support our continued growth.



We have created comprehensive Company and Installation Quality Management Systems (QMS), along with an Operations & Administration Playbook.



We are now seeking an experienced, highly organised Virtual Assistant to take responsibility for the day-to-day administration of these systems and help ensure our operations run efficiently.

- Managing customer enquiries, job files and appointments.

- Coordinating surveys, installations and customer communications.

- Liaising with surveyors, installers, subcontractors and management.

- Monitoring job progress from initial enquiry through to completion.

- Ensuring all required documents are completed and filed correctly.

- Maintaining our Company QMS and Installation QMS.

- Following and implementing our Operations & Administration Playbook.

- Maintaining compliance registers, checklists and supporting evidence.

- Monitoring company insurance, certifications and renewal dates.

- Maintaining staff and subcontractor competency, training and qualification records.

- Supporting internal audits, corrective actions and management reviews.



Installation Administration



- Checking survey reports, installation paperwork and completion records.

- Collecting and organising before, during and after installation photographs.

- Recording insulation material batch numbers, including EPS bead and adhesive, against individual jobs.

- Maintaining material traceability and installation records.

- Monitoring equipment inspections, maintenance, PAT testing and calibration where applicable.

- Ensuring outstanding documentation and compliance issues are followed up.

- Preparing customer completion, handover and guarantee documentation.



Systems & Reporting



- Maintaining organised Google Drive folders and document structures.

- Updating Excel spreadsheets, registers and job trackers.

- Monitoring outstanding tasks and deadlines.

- Producing regular progress and compliance reports.

- Identifying missing paperwork, process failures and opportunities for improvement.



Technical assessments, installation approvals and specialist compliance decisions will remain with appropriately authorised personnel.



Essential Experience



You MUST have previous experience with several of the following:



- Administration for UK insulation or retrofit companies.

- Cavity wall insulation, loft insulation or similar installation operations.

- UK installation compliance and quality assurance documentation.

- PAS 2030 / PAS 2035 administrative processes.

- TrustMark or similar certification administration.

- Installation evidence, photographic records and job-file management.

- Installer and subcontractor compliance administration.

- Audit preparation, document control and compliance registers.



Previous experience supporting ECO4 or other UK-funded energy-efficiency companies is a significant advantage because of the transferable administrative and compliance experience.



What We're Looking For



- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Exceptional organisation and attention to detail.

- Strong Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace skills.

- Experience managing large volumes of documents and job files.

- Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.

- Confidence communicating with UK-based teams.

- Proactive problem-solving and excellent time management.

- Ability to identify missing information and follow up without constant supervision.

- Willingness to work hours that overlap with UK business operations.



How to Apply



Applications without evidence of relevant industry experience will be rejected.



Please submit:



1. Your CV, including relevant UK insulation or retrofit employers and responsibilities.

2. Details of your previous experience with installation administration and compliance.

3. Which systems, portals and software platforms you have used.

4. Examples of the types of installation records, QMS documents or compliance processes you have managed.

5. Your expected hourly or monthly salary in GBP.

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to explain their previous responsibilities and complete a practical administration and compliance exercise.



We are looking for an experienced professional who can take ownership of our administration, maintain high standards and become an important part of our growing business.



If you do not have the relevant experience, please do not apply.

Run supervised live tests, then launch and support each app

Write simple documentation so someone else could run the system

NDA and background check before you get access to any live system or data

Your salary expectation and how soon you can start.

title: Python Data Engineer – Web Scraping, ETL & Data Enrichment
description:
Experience: 3+ years preferred

Location: Philippines (Remote)



About the Role



We are building a data intelligence platform that collects, structures, and presents detailed information about companies, people, investors, industries, and business relationships.



Our platform will aggregate information from multiple licensed and permitted data sources, including company databases, professional networks, industry reports, PDFs, public records, and APIs.



We are looking for an experienced Python Data Engineer / Web Scraping Specialist to help build and manage the data infrastructure behind our platform.



We need someone who can develop reliable, scalable, and automated systems to collect, clean, structure, enrich, and continuously update large amounts of business information.



You will work directly with the founder to develop our data acquisition and processing systems from the ground up.



Key Responsibilities



1. Web Scraping & Data Collection



Build and maintain Python-based web scraping and data extraction tools.



Collect structured data from permitted websites, public databases, and licensed sources.



Extract company profiles, executive information, investment history, funding rounds, industry classifications, and business relationships.



Develop automated processes for regularly updating existing records.



Work with websites containing dynamic JavaScript-rendered content.



Integrate third-party APIs and licensed data providers.



2. Data Extraction from PDFs & Documents



Extract structured information from industry research reports, financial documents, and PDFs.



Process tables, company lists, financial information, and other unstructured datasets.



Use AI/LLMs where appropriate to convert unstructured documents into structured, verifiable data.



3. Data Cleaning, Enrichment & Matching



Clean, normalize, and standardize large datasets.



Identify and remove duplicate company and people records.



Match companies and individuals across multiple data sources.



Merge information into unified company and executive profiles.



Develop processes to identify missing information, conflicting records, and inaccurate data.



4. Data Engineering & Automation



Build automated ETL/ELT pipelines.



Design and manage structured databases.



Work with PostgreSQL, SQL, JSON, CSV, and APIs.



Develop scheduled data collection and refresh processes.



Implement error handling, monitoring, logging, and data quality checks.



Maintain records of data sources, extraction dates, and provenance.



5. Database & Dashboard Integration



Prepare clean, structured datasets for our internal and customer-facing dashboards.



Integrate processed data with tools such as Noloco, 
, and other platforms where appropriate.



Ensure data can be efficiently searched, filtered, and updated.



Required Skills



You should have strong practical experience with:



Python – advanced proficiency



Web scraping – Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, Playwright, Selenium, or similar tools



Data engineering – ETL pipelines, automation, and scheduled workflows



SQL / PostgreSQL – relational database design and querying



Data processing – Pandas, JSON, CSV, data transformation



API integration – REST APIs, authentication, pagination, and data ingestion



Data cleaning – deduplication, normalization, and entity matching



PDF extraction – extracting structured data from reports and documents



Git – version control and maintainable, documented code



You must be comfortable working independently, solving technical problems, and building systems that can run repeatedly without constant manual intervention.



All extraction and integration work must follow applicable laws, source permissions, and licensing agreements.



Bonus Skills



These are not essential but would be highly valuable:



Experience building company intelligence, financial data, or business information databases



Familiarity with Crunchbase, PitchBook, LinkedIn, ITjuzi, or similar business data platforms



Experience with AI/LLM-based document extraction and data enrichment



Experience with Chinese-language websites and datasets



Experience with Supabase, AWS, or other cloud infrastructure



Experience with 
 or Noloco



Experience managing large-scale datasets containing hundreds of thousands or millions of records



Experience with entity resolution and knowledge graphs



What We're Looking For



We want someone who:



Has built real-world scraping and data processing systems, not just simple scripts



Understands how to turn messy data from multiple sources into a reliable database



Can recommend better technical approaches rather than simply following instructions



Writes clean, organized, and maintainable Python code



Is highly detail-oriented and understands data accuracy



Can work independently and communicate progress clearly



Is interested in a long-term role helping build a growing data intelligence business



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A brief introduction and summary of your Python/data engineering experience.



Examples of web scraping or ETL systems you have built.



Your experience working with SQL databases and large datasets.



Whether you have worked with company profiles, people data, investment databases, or similar datasets.



Your monthly salary expectation in USD.



Your GitHub profile or examples of previous code, if available.



Technical question:



Imagine you need to build a database containing 5000 companies. Information comes from multiple websites, APIs, and PDF reports. Many companies appear under different names, and information changes over time.



How would you design a system to collect the data, match duplicate records, verify information, and keep the database continuously updated?



Please briefly explain the technologies and approach you would use.



Applications that demonstrate practical experience and a clear technical approach will be prioritized.



We are looking for someone who can grow with the business and eventually take ownership of our data engineering infrastructure.

 campaigns to the client database, such as seasonal service offers

s: prompt, warm and clear

ServiceM8: advanced and non-negotiable, including automations, quote follow-up sequences, SMS templates and the ServiceM8 phone app

Social media posting and replies, Meta Business Suite, Canva, basic video editing, and using AI tools to create content

Proven experience running Meta Ads, Google Ads and
 campaigns is highly valued; some genuine paid ads exposure is expected

Organisational Skills
